one_liner: iMessage revenue channel for DTC brands that brings customers back
long_description: Signals is a new iMessage revenue channel for DTC ecommerce brands that gets customers to buy again. After a purchase, we open a real two-way conversation over iMessage, the channel customers actually read and reply to, and turn it into repeat revenue. In A/B tests, that drives ~$30 in average incremental repeat revenue per conversation.

name: Sila
one_liner: Agentic Messenger
long_description: Sila is the team messenger for your people and agents to work together, becoming the AI infrastructure your company grows on. Our mission is to bring superintelligence to all companies around the world.

name: Sitefire
one_liner: Marketing suite for the agentic web
long_description: Sitefire (YC W26) helps brands market their products to agents. They create content and tools that get their products discovered and used by AI agents (ChatGPT, OpenClaw). Sitefire identifies which content drives AI visibility, and automatically creates it. The teams using Sitefire execute on-page and off-page actions to deliver measurable top-line growth.

name: Skillsync
one_liner: Search your agent session history
agent_hits: agent; agent; agents; agent; agents; agent; agent
long_description: Skillsync makes your agent session history searchable. Both for you and your coding agents. It searches all your sessions before each prompt and hands your agent what you already figured out. It gives you one place for everything your agents have ever done. Move a full session between Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any other agent with nothing lost, including the entire conversation, the model's reasoning, and every tool call, not just a summary, so the next agent picks up like it was there the whole time. Skillsync is local-first and yours, and its core engine, txcript, is open source, a portable session format that no single provider owns.

name: Sparkles
one_liner: Make everyone on your team an engineer
long_description:
Sparkles gives your whole team coding agents that work on your real codebase. 
 
Connect your GitHub repos once, and anyone on the team can start a run from the web app or by @mentioning Sparkles in Slack. Pick Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode and describe the change in plain language. The agent works in an isolated cloud sandbox with your tools already plugged in, like Linear, Sentry, Notion and Figma. You can watch every command and file edit live and jump in mid-run. 
 
Every run ends as a GitHub pull request. CI checks stream back into Sparkles, and your reviews and branch protections still apply, so prod stays safe.

name: Sponge
one_liner: Financial infrastructure for the agent economy
agent_hits: agent; agents; agents; agents; agents; Agents; agents; agents
agent_infra_hits: for agents; agent economy; agents to hold; lets agents
long_description:
Sponge is the easiest way for agents to hold and spend money, and for businesses to sell directly to them. 
 
For agents: Sponge lets agents hold funds and transact autonomously with other agents and businesses using bank accounts, cards, and crypto. Agents can autonomously purchase services such as email, browser use, and premium data without human involvement. 
 
For businesses: Sponge makes it easy to onboard and accept payments from agents without human interaction. Businesses can sell their services directly to agents with a few clicks, no code changes required.

name: SpotPay
one_liner: Stablecoin Global Bank Account
long_description: SpotPay is a global borderless neobank. We give users one account that works for everything payments related: receiving money from abroad, paying locally, spending anywhere with the SpotPay card and saving and earning on their balance.

name: Squid
one_liner: AI agents for power grid planning  🦑
long_description:
We believe the electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth. If we want electrification to move fast, the teams planning and operating networks need software that is as modern as the challenge. 
 
Our thesis is simple. Better decisions come from one unified, trusted network model. When everyone works from the same model, planning becomes consistent, assumptions are visible, and progress stops getting lost in spreadsheets and static reports. 
 
Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser. We have spent years inside National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS, building and learning what breaks. Now we are building what we wished existed.

name: Standard Physics
one_liner: Fast Physics Simulations for Rapid Design and Real Time Control
long_description:
Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) builds AI that does real physics. Most AI tools approximate physical behavior and get it wrong in ways engineers can’t see. Ours run actual numerical solvers, so the results are accurate enough to make real engineering decisions on. 
 
We have three products built on one engine. 
 
Reynolds runs computational fluid dynamics for you. An engineer describes the flow in plain language, and Reynolds writes the OpenFOAM case, builds the mesh, runs the solver, and returns the figures, the numbers, and a case they can rerun. It’s open source. 
 
Archimedes searches the design itself. Swarms of agents try thousands of layouts in parallel, simulate each one through Reynolds, keep what the physics rewards, and redraw the search space when the best answer was never in the original plan. We sell it as outcome-based engineering: customers pay for a better design, not for compute. 
 
Inviscid AI (now a product!) points the same engine at a running building. It holds a data center within its thermal limits in real time, computed continuously from live telemetry. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality.  
 
We work with hardware startups and engineering teams on data center cooling, drones, energy systems, piping, and electronics. Reynolds earns engineers’ trust in daily use, and Archimedes and Inviscid AI turn that trust into large contracts.

name: Stilta
one_liner: Agentic AI for intellectual property
long_description:
Stilta builds agentic AI software for intellectual property, starting with patent litigation. Whether challenging or enforcing a patent, leading IP law firms and in-house IP teams use Stilta for source-backed, auditable analysis. 
 
Innovation drives the world's most important breakthroughs, but the tools that protect it haven't kept pace. Patent attorneys do high-stakes work with a process still built on manual document review and disconnected point solutions. Generative AI helps with drafting, but it doesn't deliver the trust and transparency that legal-grade work demands - no sources, no traceability, no audit trail. Stilta takes a different approach. We use agentic AI to run search and analysis at a scale manual methods can't match, with every output source-backed, referenced, and auditable. Until recently, this wasn't technically possible. 
 
We're four engineers from McKinsey/QuantumBlack who built and deployed AI systems at some of the world's largest organizations. With Stilta, we're equipping the people who protect the world's most valuable ideas with tools that match the stakes.

name: Strand AI
one_liner: Multimodal foundation models to predict uncollected patient biology
long_description: Strand AI develops foundation models to generate missing bio-data about patients. With this imputed data, pharmaceutical companies can select better patients for their drug trials and shave months from their drug launch timelines. We’ve already trained a multimodal foundation model that integrates spatial biology modalities, beating SOTA at a fraction of the cost.

name: Synthetic Sciences
one_liner: Infrastructure for Autonomous Science
long_description: Synthetic Sciences is a research lab building infrastructure for scientific superintelligence. Empirical science is bottlenecked by verification that is slow, expensive, and imperfect. We work on tooling, evals, training environments, algorithms, and labs that make autonomous science possible.

name: Talking Computers
one_liner: Real-time interaction models for voice agents
long_description:
AI lab building interaction models to make AI symbiotic with humans. 
 
Our early models sit at the Pareto frontier of intelligence and interactivity, measured by time to first audio token, and enable voice agents that are both highly capable and genuinely human-like

name: TensorTest
one_liner: AI training data, evals, and RL environments
long_description:
TensorTest works with AI labs, robotics companies, and enterprises across the stack, from pre-training and post-training data to reinforcement learning (RL) environments and evaluations.

We scope and run custom datasets, production traces, environments, and evaluation suites, and staff domain experts onto client teams.

TimelineBench and CharacterBench are examples of our published evaluation work.

name: Tepali
one_liner: AI EMR for medical aesthetics & wellness
long_description: Tepali is the AI EMR for medspas & wellness clinics. Front desk, charting, point of sale, and marketing in one system, with an AI employee that books new leads, charts every appointment, and brings past clients back.

name: Terminal Use
one_liner: AI-native transformation for operations-heavy companies
long_description:
AI pilots are everywhere. Few organizations can point to a department that actually runs AI-first. Terminal Use changes that. 
 
We help operations teams rebuild how work gets done, end to end. We begin with one critical process, map how it runs today and where it breaks, then redesign the workflow around AI agents, existing systems, and people at the right control points. 
The result is a working AI-first process, measurable operational change, and a blueprint for transforming the broader department. 
 
Founded by ex-Palantir FDEs and engineers working on transformation at scale, Terminal Use works across construction, logistics, manufacturing, retail, and other complex operating environments.

name: Terranox AI
one_liner: The first AI-powered uranium discovery company
long_description: Terranox is the first vertically integrated AI-powered uranium exploration company. We find high-grade uranium deposits in North America using AI trained on 70+ years of exploration outcomes. Our mission is to find the fuel we need to power the next century with nuclear energy.

name: The Token Company
one_liner: Compression middleware that improves LLM outputs
long_description:
Compression middleware that removes context bloat in milliseconds, lowering costs and improving end-to-end latency. 
 
Compression is especially effective across natural language workloads. In a blind LLM arena case study with one of our customers, compressed requests increased user preference, lowered costs, and lifted purchase volume by 5%.

name: Traverse
one_liner: On a mission to keep the future in human hands.
long_description:
Humans control the future because we are the most intelligent species on Earth. We believe AI will soon change that, and that our control is at risk. As a research lab, we study AI alignment and model psychology to ensure these systems have our best interests at heart. We post-train models for companies on the same principle, so that the models they rely on are their own and act in their interest.  
We are a small team of researchers and engineers, and we’re hiring!

name: Travo
one_liner: AI-native commercial real estate brokerage
long_description: Travo is building an AI-native commercial real estate brokerage. Our AI brings together what we know about each property, the people involved, and the terms they’re likely to accept. Our brokers use that insight to find the right fit for buyers, secure better prices for sellers, and close deals faster.

name: Turnstone
one_liner: The best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative
long_description:
Turnstone is the best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative. Run persistent Agents on your Mac with the AI subscriptions or API keys you already have 
 
On Turnstone, you can connect multiple AI subscriptions / API keys in one place, and build a team of agents just like you would on Grokbot.  
 
When a subscription runs out, your Agent can automatically move to another connected subscription with available capacity. You can switch between accounts and model providers within an agent, and its conversation and context persists.

name: Unifold
one_liner: Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure
long_description:
Launch crypto deposits in minutes.  
 
Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works. 
 
If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.

name: Unisson
one_liner: AI agents that automate B2B software implementation
long_description:
Unisson is building trusted AI subject-matter experts for teams that are responsible for customer deployments (technical customer success, implementation, sales engineering). Within 20 minutes, our agents learn to use any product and can be used by teams in Slack, text, or email. Our agents gather requirements and context from existing tools enabling them to handle complex tasks like customer health audits, onboarding, product administration, and custom integrations.  
 
With Unisson, customer-facing teams have 24/7 access to an AI SME, allowing them to scale and save thousands of hours.

name: Valence
one_liner: Unified prediction markets trading platform
long_description: Valence is a unified trading platform for prediction markets. We provide infrastructure to aggregate and execute contracts across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other platforms, surface arbitrage and mispricing opportunities in real time, and give systematic traders the API and backtesting tools they need to build and execute data-driven strategies on anything.

name: Valgo
one_liner: Insurance risk layer for autonomy
long_description:
Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk. 
 
Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.

name: Vector Legal
one_liner: A premier AI-native law firm & legal operating system for Startups.
long_description:
A modern solution for Startup legal. 
 
Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 13+ years of experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials. 
 
Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts and commercial contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.

name: Vela
one_liner: AI Recruiting Coordinator for Executive Search
long_description:
Scheduling one interview panel takes a dozen emails. Then someone moves a call and you start over.  
 
Vela is an AI Scheduling Coordinator that handles it end to end. Just CC Vela on the thread like you would a person. It reaches out, finds times that work for everyone, chases the people who don't reply, reschedules when things change, and confirms. Over email, SMS, and WhatsApp, at any hour your candidate happens to respond. 
 
No dashboard. No new workflow. Your team works the way it already works, without the scheduling.

name: Velum Labs
one_liner: The OS for data quality across any stack
long_description:
Velum is the operating system for data quality. Velum automatically monitors and enforces data quality across a company's data stack, so bad data never reaches dashboards. We turn data quality from a manual task into infrastructure that runs itself. 
 
Data trust you can prove. From the pipeline to the boardroom.

name: Ventura
one_liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
long_description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

name: Verdex
one_liner: AI Verification for Insurance
long_description: Verdex is an AI insurance adjuster. We use data streams like satellite imagery to verify claims, allowing insurers to process it immediately and save billions of dollars. We are currently helping insure over 11% of all American farmland.

name: Veriad
one_liner: AI operating system for advertising
long_description: Veriad is building marketing agents for enterprises to run advertising campaigns end-to-end in-house.

name: Visibl Semiconductors
one_liner: Custom silicon for power electronics
long_description:
Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost. 
 
We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances. 
 
V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly. 
 
We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.

name: Voltair
one_liner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
long_description:
Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. 
 
Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage. 
 
With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance. 
 
We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.

name: Voxel Energy
one_liner: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.
long_description:
The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays.  
 
By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.

name: VOYGR
one_liner: The real-world intelligence and action layer
long_description:
VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world. 
 
Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act. 20M+ apps/websites, up to 40% of search queries, and 20% of LLM prompts need local context.  
10-15 attributes per place are not enough for AI. Places change constantly - restaurants close, hours change, businesses move. LLMs struggle with semantic queries “Specialty coffee shops in SF with Wi-Fi, popular with YC founders”. Agents cannot reliably “parse half the internet” - they need real-world ontology 
 
We’re experienced builders in maps, search, and ML to solve this. Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta.  
 
Google Places alone is a $XXB/Yr monopoly. Agents turn it into a transactional layer opportunity for local commerce and ads.

name: Wayco
one_liner: AI operator for medlegal cases
long_description: Wayco is building a unified data intelligence layer for medical treatment of legal cases. From the first intake to instant settlement.

name: Wideframe
one_liner: We help video teams deliver better edits, faster.
long_description:
We help video teams deliver better edits, faster. 
 
Video editing is going the way of software engineering. It’s becoming AI-native, and that shift is elevating today’s editors into creative strategists, producers, and orchestrators of AI agents. 
 
Our co-founder and CEO wrote about this shift here: https://danielpearson.substack.com/p/how-ai-took-my-job 
 
We build for teams, not solo creators. Our customers produce episodic content for TV and YouTube, juggle multiple client deadlines, or run high-volume commercial content inside brands. 
 
For our customers, videos are never done. They’re just due. We help with the work in between.

name: Zatanna
one_liner: Building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software
long_description: Zatanna is building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software. AI agents are increasingly capable of performing work that was previously done by humans, but they're still constrained by software interfaces designed for people. Today, agents rely heavily on clicking buttons, navigating pages, and interacting with UIs to get things done. At Zatanna, we're changing that by reverse engineering applications to turn their underlying workflows and actions into reliable, read-and-write APIs, regardless of whether those applications offer APIs themselves.

name: ZeroSettle
one_liner: iMessage API for businesses and AI agents
long_description:
ZeroSettle is an iMessage API. Each customer gets a dedicated phone number that sends and receives real iMessages from their own code or AI agent. Plans start at $49/month. 
 
Developers send and receive messages through a REST API and webhooks. AI agents connect through our MCP server, which works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor. Each number supports photos, videos, voice memos, typing indicators, inline replies, polls, group chats and FaceTime Audio calls. For teams that don’t want to write code, a built-in AI agent can answer texts for them, and conversations sync to Close, GoHighLevel, and HubSpot. 
 
Companies use ZeroSettle for customer support, sales follow-up, appointment reminders, retention offers, Sign in with iMessage, and AI assistants that live in iMessage. iMessage needs no 10DLC registration, and each number handles up to 10,000 messages a day on Apple hardware we operate in a server facility.

name: Zymbly
one_liner: The decision-support layer for aviation ops teams to know what to do…

name: 9 Mothers
one_liner: Counter Drone Systems. $1.6m sales. We delivered for the DoW.
long_description:
Pre demo day, June 2026:  
 
We have sold $1.6m of systems to the DoW. Multiple systems delivered to the DoW. 
 
Our first product - EDDA - is a counter drone system - small, low power, low cost fully autonomous-capable. It's designed to be used on vehicles, bases, or carried - to stop group 1 suicide drones. We have multiple contracts, sales, etc. 
 
We have 3 more products with demand in various stages of development. 
 
More details at https://9mothers.com

name: AbInitio Bio
one_liner: The Intelligence layer for Drug Manufacturing
long_description: Abinitio Bio builds foundation models for biomanufacturing, validated against wet lab data. Our first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes more accurately than standard models, and any pharma or CDMO can adapt it to their own workflow instantly. By making process decisions that take 6-18 months today in hours, we help teams avoid the cost of delay on a single program.

name: Adialante
one_liner: Cancer screening without barriers
long_description:
We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early.  
 
MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world.  
 
Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.

name: Advanced Metal Research
one_liner: Machine intelligence for American Welding
long_description:
America does not just need more welders. It needs welding knowledge that can scale. 
 
The American Welding Society projects 320,500 new welding professionals will be needed by 2029, with about 80,000 jobs to be filled annually from 2025 to 2029. More than 157,000 current welding professionals are approaching retirement. Welders are only a small share of the skilled-trades workforce, but welding accounts for an outsized share of projected capability demand.  
 
The market calls it a labor shortage. AMR sees a learning bottleneck. 
 
We are building American-made robotic welding cells that combine computer vision to provide real-time seam tracking and post-weld inspection to turn welding from a scarce manual process into a closed-loop manufacturing system that learns from every weld as it happens.

name: Aernata
one_liner: Making clean fuels out of CO2.
long_description:
Aernata is an American chemicals company producing clean fuel from industrial emissions. 
 
We're starting by converting CO2 to methanol for synthetic fuel production.

name: AgentPhone
one_liner: Phone Numbers for AI Agents
long_description: The $2T global telecom industry was built for humans. Agents can't act in the real world today because without a phone number, they lack identity. AgentPhone gives every AI agent its own phone number to reach people and businesses through messages and calls.

name: AGI Deployment Company
one_liner: Diffusing AI into critical industries
long_description: We rebuild the companies that are most critical to our economy and hardest to displace around general intelligence.

name: AICE
one_liner: Submarine drones for defense
long_description: We are building the next generation of underwater defense systems: autonomous swarms of modular marine drones to secure naval assets and coastal infrastructure against evolving underwater threats.

name: Akkari
one_liner: Autonomous Customer Operations
long_description:
Akkari runs the operational work from the first sales call through expansion. It captures and stays on top of every commitment, issue, request and opportunity across customer channels (Slack, calls, meetings, email, Discord, etc.) then drives each loop to resolution - our wedge toward building the AI execution system for companies. 
 
We are 2x YC founders who scaled OrderAhead (acquired by Square) to millions of users and BLADE to $1.2B+ in monthly trading volume.

name: Alchemize
one_liner: Building AI Native Customs Brokerages

name: Allowance
one_liner: The spend control layer for AI agents
agent_infra_hits: for AI agents; lets AI agents
long_description:
Allowance lets AI agents make purchases on a user’s behalf without ever exposing your real card number. 
 
Users approve purchases directly from their iPhone with customizable controls like spending limits, merchant restrictions, and expiration windows. Once approved, Allowance generates scoped, one-time payment credentials designed specifically for that transaction. 
 
This enables AI agents to safely complete tasks like shopping, ordering food, booking reservations, or purchasing tickets while keeping humans in control of every payment.

name: Amboras
one_liner: AI Native Shopify
long_description: Amboras puts your entire e-commerce on autopilot. It builds your store, continuously optimizes it, reads your analytics, and learns what converts - all autonomously. No developers. No agencies. No guessing. Today it sells to humans. Tomorrow it sells to AI agents.

name: Andco
one_liner: Agents that build personal injury cases
long_description: Our agents retrieve and synthesize all the records law firms need to start a personal injury case. We get police reports, open insurance claims, and retrieve all the medical records and bills needed to build a case.

name: ANORIA
one_liner: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
long_description: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.

name: Antinuous
one_liner: Autonomous research agents for R&D and applied science
long_description:
Antinuous is building the platform to run 100x more research, experiments, and simulations, 1,000x cheaper. 
 
The platform combines a research agent, compute clusters, and hardware-tuned simulation software to give every agent access to research primitives that are typically reserved for massive R&D orgs, saving days per week on research iteration.

name: Apollo Atomics, Inc.
one_liner: We make the most compact nuclear reactors

name: AquaShield
one_liner: AI water leak detection for buildings
long_description: AquaShield protects large real estate portfolios against water damage (losses of up to hundreds of millions per year).

name: Arctic Health
one_liner: AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare
long_description:
Arctic Health is building AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare organizations. We automate the full workflow, from establishing payer contracts to enrolling each provider. We collect and validate organization and provider data according to each state and payer’s requirements, and submit on the organization's behalf. We then monitor status and compliance on an ongoing basis. 
 
Tools on the market today either perform small pieces of the workflow or price out small and mid-sized organizations. We handle the process end-to-end regardless of organization type or size. Our browser automations enable AI agents to submit and monitor across hundreds of payer portals, and our system is trained by experienced industry experts who handle every edge case. 
 
Healthcare organizations get one simple platform. We handle the rest.

name: Arden
one_liner: AI operating system for factories
long_description:
Arden is building AI that runs factories. We connect every machine, sensor, operator and piece of software in a plant into a live model of how the factory actually works. From there, our agents schedule production, monitor machines in real time, model capacity and cost, and handle quoting and purchasing. 
 
Our mission is to arm American factories with frontier intelligence and make them the most productive in the world.

name: Ardent
one_liner: Database sandboxes for Agents
long_description: Clone any postgres DB regardless of size in 6s so agents can test their work

name: Arga Labs
one_liner: Real-world sandboxes to test and train AI agents
long_description:
We build environments to test your app and agents against the real world. 
 
Deploy your code/agent into a sandbox that runs against replicas of external services (Stripe, Slack, Google Drive, etc.). Twins support the same APIs, MCP tool calls & SDKs as the real software, and you can spin up thousands of instances in parallel and seed them using natural language. Run real workflows, surface edge cases, and observe how your code/agents actually behave before hitting production.

name: Arlo Industries
one_liner: Track drones and missiles without radars - Accurate, Passive, Scalable
long_description:
Arlo Industries is building a network of sensors that precisely tracks stealthy drones and aerial threats better than radars. 
 
This capability does not exist yet because traditional radars are built on past war doctrines designed to protect single, centralised assets. Modern warfare, however, demands wide-area, persistent coverage that is both passive and economically scalable. By utilising a mesh architecture, Arlo Industries unlocks unprecedented asymmetric economics. The network is fundamentally built to scale: the cost of adding sensors grows linearly, but the tracking accuracy increases exponentially, delivering highly resilient, persistent coverage for a fraction of the cost of legacy systems. 
 
Deo founded Arlo Industries after spending over 6 years in the Israeli defence ecosystem, where he lived through multiple conflicts and experienced the Iron Dome and other systems in action against ICBMs and the infamous Shahed drones. Learning exactly how these defence systems could be improved after a Shahed exploded close to his apartment, he built Arlo Industries around the core philosophy that conflict should be concise & precise. 
 
The people behind Arlo1 includes a PhD in drones and autonomy and military experts.

Auxos builds AI customer twins for marketing, product, and research teams to test their hypotheses at scale. long_description: BayMachines deploys on-prem, air-gapped GPU containers for defense teams to run and fine-tune AI locally. We support defense technology companies serving the DoW and special operations, with deployments built to support CMMC and NIST 800-171 requirements.

name: BioStack Platforms
one_liner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
ai_core_hits: AI; ML; reinforcement learning; AI models
long_description:
BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments. 
 
We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.

name: Callab AI
one_liner: Human-centered AI for contact centers.
agent_hits: agents; agents; agent; agents; Agents; agents; agents; Agents; agent; agent
long_description:
Callab AI is a human-centered customer engagement platform for enterprise contact centers. It lets teams deploy AI agents that handle inbound and outbound conversations across voice, chat, and messaging, while human agents and supervisors stay in control of every interaction. 
 
The platform has two sides. The AI side lets teams build, deploy, and evaluate voice and text agents using a shared knowledge base, embedded evaluations, post-call analysis, data extraction, batch calling, and call transfer. The human side provides a dialer and a live supervision dashboard, from which a person can watch any AI conversation in real time, step in, and hand it back without the customer repeating a word. 
 
Every agent retains memory across channels, so a customer who called yesterday and writes today is recognized and picked up where they left off. The system learns from each human intervention and improves in the direction the team chooses. 
 
Callab AI runs on its own carrier-grade telephony stack and connects natively to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX systems. Enterprises can adopt it without migrating to the cloud first. The platform maintains SOC 2 controls and serves customers in financial services, healthcare, hospitality, and retail. 
 
Key features: 
 
- AI voice and text agents: Agents handle inbound and outbound conversations across phone, chat, and messaging from a single configuration. 
 
- Live human supervision: Supervisors watch any AI conversation in real time and take over without the customer repeating a word. 
 
- Persistent memory: Every customer's full context is retained across channels and over time. 
 
- AI builder: Teams design, test, and deploy agents without engineering support. 
 
- Embedded evaluations: Every conversation is scored continuously, so performance is measured rather than assumed. 
 
- Self-improving agents: Agents learn from human interventions and get better with every conversation. 
 
- Post-call analysis and data extraction: Every conversation becomes structured, searchable records. 
 
- Batch calling and call transfer: Outbound campaigns run at scale, and conversations move to a human with full context attached. 
 
- Native telephony integration: The platform connects directly to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX without cloud migration. 
 
- SOC 2 controls: Security and compliance support deployments in regulated industries. 
 
Callab AI delivers every agent production-ready. Our team studies the customer's workflows, internal processes, and existing systems, then builds, tests, and implements the agent on that foundation, so it performs to the organization's own standard from the first live conversation.

name: CharacterQuilt

name: Current
one_liner: Run hundreds of coding agents and stay in control
agent_hits: agents; agents; agents; agents; agents; agents; agent; agents
long_description:
Current is an opinionated way to work with your coding agents. It lets you run hundreds of agents while staying in control. 
 
The problem with running agents in parallel isn't their intelligence. It's your attention. You end up scrolling walls of text and tool calls, looking for answers you'd already been given. 
 
So Current drops the chat entirely and focuses on your agents' outputs, not their inputs. Everything is an issue, from a quick fix to a big project with sub-issues. You write it, and your agents pick it up and deliver. 
 
When they're done, they notify you and show you what they made: a report, a chart, a before and after video, or an interactive app that shows their work. You review the work, not how they got there. Comment and the agent goes back to work. Approve and it merges. 
 
Current is built with Current. It's free on Mac, Windows, Linux and iPhone, and works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and many more agents.

Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. name: Enjamb Labs

They learn how a team works, then do the work in Slack, in Teams, and in the systems themselves, across preclinical research, clinical evidence, trial design, statistical programming, and regulatory submissions. 
 
This is AI tailored for how medicine gets made.

name: Expanse

long_description:
Expanse delivers compute certainty. Its software predicts exactly what every AI workload needs before it runs, so organisations can do more with the GPU infrastructure they already own, privately and on their own hardware. 
 
Every AI breakthrough begins with a compute decision, and today that decision is a guess. Ask for too little and the job dies hours in. Ask for too much and the hardware sits reserved and idle while other work waits. Expanse replaces the guess with evidence, before a single GPU is committed.

This intelligence explosion will expand what a firm can deliver: deeper investigations, bigger problems, and entirely new types of engagements.

Once deployed, consultants run their engagements on Foaster, while our dedicated team maintains the infrastructure and advances its capabilities through applied research and benchmarking on real consulting work. 
 
Each engagement builds a knowledge graph of the client that can be reused and extended in future work. Approved lessons strengthen the firm’s methods, while advances in models expand its capabilities. Over time, each firm builds its own intelligence layer, grounded in its expertise and the organizations it serves.

Today, drug and device companies outsource clinical operations to legacy CROs and their massive teams, which is why the CRO market is $82B annually. Harbor delivers the regulated services companies buy from legacy CROs, but built around our AI-native system of record from day one. Our software already automates the core data workflows: study build, data capture, query generation, monitoring, signing, and database lock. Because we own the system of record, we can expand into the surrounding service workflows: site contracting and billing, subject engagement and retention, statistics, reporting, and more. 
 
We built Harbor because we lived through the problem. Albert spent four years in clinical trials and regulatory strategy at a medical device startup, taking an unproven wearable from first-in-human trials to FDA authorization. name: InLoop Robotics

long_description:

Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order.

name: Kimpton
one_liner: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work
long_description:
In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it. 
 
Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on. 
 
The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade. 
 
Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss. 
 
That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule. 
 
We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack. 
 
We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.

name: Kinect
one_liner: The AI revenue platform for D2C brands
agent_hits: agents; agent; agents; agent; agent; agents
long_description:
Kinect builds AI agents that know your brand, your catalog, and your customers. On your site, they sell every visitor — running the conversation, adapting product pages in real time to each customer segment, picking the right recommendation for the question being asked. The agent picks up on what each shopper actually wants from how they ask, what they hesitate on, what they compare, and what objection makes them bounce.  
 
We take all of a brand's data and make a structured catalog, brand voice, fit notes, return reasons, segment-level nuance — all so the Kinect agents truly can speak about a brand. When an agent describes the brand, the version it describes is the one you'd want them to, not whatever it guessed from a public catalog scrape. We expose this data as well in the form of agent storefronts, letting every other AI talk about your brand in the way you would want too. 
 
We're building for human shoppers today and the AI agents that shop and discover for them. Either way, the entire website needs to get a lot smarter and personalized.  
 
Two surfaces. One layer. Built for scaling DTC ecommerce brands.

name: Klaimee
one_liner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
agent_hits: Agents; agents; agents; agentic; agentic; agents; agent; agent
long_description:
Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. 
Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. 
 
The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off. 
 
Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance). 
 
We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.

name: Klarify

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it. 
 
Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients. 
 
Nearly 12,300 therapists use Klarify today. 
 
Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.

name: Lumius
one_liner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
long_description:
Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. 
 
Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable. 
 
We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.

name: Masterpiece
one_liner: Working capital for data companies training frontier AI
long_description:
We believe AI will be one of humanity’s next great masterpieces. Building it will require financial infrastructure as ambitious as the companies creating it. We're founders backed by Y Combinator building the financial rails underpinning the AI data economy. 
 
Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs. 
 
A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. This creates a 30 to 90 day cash gap between when vendors incur costs and when they receive payment. Legacy invoice lenders have little visibility into how to underwrite these assets. 
 
Masterpiece closes that gap by advancing capital against high quality lab contracts and invoices. Vendors can use the capital to scale delivery, pay contributors, and fund growth, then repay masterpiece when the lab payment arrives.

name: Memoir
one_liner: AI in your calls
long_description:
Memoir is an AI teammate that joins your video calls, listens like everyone else, and only talks when you talk to it. 
 
A founder is on a sales call. The customer asks what a pilot would look like. Instead of promising to send something over, the founder says, "Memoir, draft this up." A few seconds later there's a page in the chat with the plan they just talked through. Everyone opens it, and they go through it together before anyone hangs up. Afterward, Memoir can help the founder follow up on what they promised, with one click. 
 
Most calls end with a list of things people said they'd do, and it takes days to do them. Agents already do real work in our email, our browsers and our code. They've become extensions of us. But on calls, most of them still just take notes. 
 
We're starting with technical founders on the sales and design calls they run in Google Meet. But we want every call to work like that one. Eventually everyone will bring their own agents to a call, and those agents will work together the way the people do.

name: Aerogen Systems
one_liner: Modernizing Chip Manufacturing Infrastructure
long_description:
We are building the future of chip manufacturing. 
 
Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible. 
 
We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible? 
 
Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airborne molecular contaminants before they reach the wafer. Instead of fighting contamination by constantly flooding tools with ultra-high-purity nitrogen, Talos keeps the environment inside the machine 10–100x cleaner, without the massive purge-gas bill. 
 
Talos is powerful on its own, but it is also the foundation for a much bigger vision: the Cleanpipe. 
 
The Aerogen Systems Cleanpipe is an ultra-clean interconnect infrastructure that protects wafers as they move from machine to machine across the fab. Rather than relying on a billion-dollar cleanroom to protect every cubic foot of factory space, Cleanpipe creates a controlled environment only where cleanliness actually matters: around the wafer. 
 
Talos cleans the tools. Cleanpipe connects them. Eventually, we delete the cleanroom and build more advanced chips, at greater scale, with radically less infrastructure. With cleanpipes connecting tools, chip fabs can exist anywhere.

name: Caution
one_liner: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked
long_description:
Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. 
 
Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running. 
 
We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production. 
 
As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.

agent_hits: agent; agent; agent; agent; agents; AI workforce
long_description:

Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step.

They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed. Access is specific to the task at hand and reassessed as the agent works. 
 
Companies will rent intelligence from AI labs or run open-source models to power their agents. They’ll own the models that keep their entire AI workforce acting in their interests. Decawork is building those models.

name: DeepReach Inc.
one_liner: Network for Physical AI Data Business
long_description:
Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, 
real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the 
physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one 
has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every 
day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. 
 
DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture 
wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who 
run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens 
and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the 
software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data 
business. 
 
That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside 
one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments — 
which is what actually makes robot policies generalize. 
 
475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new 
partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three 
months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production 
with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to

name: Egoist Machines
one_liner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
long_description:
Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose. 
 
AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data. 
 
Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access. 
 
We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers. 
 
The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use. 
 
Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.

name: Fabraix
one_liner: The world's frontier hacker of AI agents.
agent_hits: agents; agents; agents; agents; agent; agents; agent
long_description:
Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies.  
 
AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions. 
 
We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
