name: Floracene
one_liner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
tags: Health Tech|Medical Devices|Digital Health|Enterprise Software|Healthcare IT
long_description:
Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. 
 
The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production. 
 
A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption. 
 
Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

name: Florin
one_liner: Florin is an AI-native insurance company that runs autonomously
long_description: Florin is building a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terrafirma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.

name: FlowManual
one_liner: AI for Construction's Back Office
long_description:
FlowManual is the all-in-one AI estimating, bidding, and purchasing platform for both general and MEP construction contractors. 
 
Built by two engineers and Harvard dropouts, FlowManual automates the buying process during pre-construction. With FlowManual, specialty contractors win more work while general contractors deliver at higher standards.

name: Frontier Computing
one_liner: Frontier grows scalable biological brains as an ML training substrate
long_description:
Frontier is first to grow biological brains at scale, serving biological neural nets with substrate-level colocation of memory and compute, enabling highly cost effective training of large parameter count models. 
 
While academia has traditionally been limited to ~1M neurons in vitro, Frontier has built a pathway to scale to 100M+ neurons by circumventing traditional scaling challenges in biological culture, demonstrating this strategy's functionality by training a biological brain using this scaling primitive to play Frogger. 
 
Frontier is now growing exascale compute clusters to produce substrates capable of long-horizon language reasoning while operating at much higher sample efficiencies than traditional architectures, and collocating memory with compute to enable significantly larger parameter counts than would be tractable for training within traditional compute clusters.

name: Gamgee
one_liner: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.
long_description:
​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved 
 
Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring 
 
​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next

name: General Context Labs
one_liner: Building Products and Datasets for Frontier Models
long_description: General Context Labs builds products and datasets that push the limits of frontier models. Our initial breakout product, Instaplay is an interactive app-generation platform home to over 100,000 users who create and discover content.

name: GitCafe
one_liner: The Git forge for the next hundred billion commits
long_description: We build GitHub for agents. We're rebuilding the infrastructure for the next hundred billion commits and CI jobs with hundreds of engineers already making the move.

name: Glen
one_liner: Institutional Learning Layer for Every Agent in Your Company
agent_hits: Agent; agent; agent; agent; agents; agent; Agents; agent; agent
long_description:
Glen is the layer that unifies every agent your company runs. Glen pulls in agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus Slack messages, GitHub prs, tickets, docs and calls. When a new agent picks up a task, Glen finds relevant prior context and injects it in the agents context window to steer it, producing knowledge work that is significantly higher quality, faster and cheaper. 
 
Glen does more. You can query the original agent behind any line of code, or search every session your org has ever run. It distills what your team does into skills and surfaces the right one automatically. Agents work multiplayer, picking up the style and context of whoever else is on the file. Transcripts are unified across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, so you can hand a session from one to another mid-task. And Glen can also double as a company brain, from Slack, in app, or by just installing Glen on any agent. 
 
We’re building toward a future where memory is no longer the missing piece of intelligence. A future where every agent maintains a lossless and continuous thread of institutional experience enabling the era of the compounding organization and fully unsupervised digital labour.

name: Graphify Labs
one_liner: Shared Context of Codebase for Agents and Developers
long_description:
Graphify is a Knowledge Graph control plane for enterprise software. The open-source tool has 152K+ GitHub stars and 11.5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Shopify, Datadog, JP Morgan, American Express, Harvey, Automation Anywhere, and Vanguard. 
 
On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess. 
 
The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads. 
 
It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.

name: Greypoint Industries
one_liner: Building drone swarms that hunt hidden enemies.
long_description: We build LEGION, a drone swarm that identifies, geolocates, and tracks every emitter on the battlefield using the enemy’s own radio signals. LEGION enables our warfighters to precisely track previously obscured targets like jammers, command posts, and drone operators so they can proactively respond to threats instead of reacting to them.

name: Grip
one_liner: Robots for waste manipulation
physical_hits: Robots; manipulation; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipulation layer for trash in general, making waste processing and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.

name: Grocalo
one_liner: AI brain for creators that runs their social content
long_description:
Grocalo (S26) is an AI brain that runs content for creators. We understand their audiences, using video understanding and deep platform analytics to bottle up the taste behind each creator and personalize and distribute content to creator specific audiences. 
 
Grocalo generated 2B views and gained 4M followers for our creators in the last 2 months. Some of our clients include Jimmy O. Yang (Comedian, 11M followers), King Bach (72M followers), Leenda Dong (28M followers), Steven He (30M followers), Sheena Melwani (18M followers), and Jeannie Mai (TV host, 6M followers). 
 
Content should be personalized and data-driven. We’ve developed the most advanced AI brain replicating viral content for any given audience.

name: GUILD
one_liner: Making Defense Manufacturing Faster and Cheaper
long_description: GUILD is an AI-Native Defense prime making aerospace parts faster and cheaper. We win defense contracts, automate manufacturing, and deliver to the government's door.

name: Gutgutgoose
one_liner: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing
long_description:
Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself. 
Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.

name: hardware intelligence
one_liner: make sense of silicon
long_description: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools to cut development by months. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal called a waveform - but it can take days to generate and can be 100s of GB. Our breakthrough is WaveZip, which captures waveforms 8x faster and 500x smaller. We're also building Wavelength, an agentic telemetry layer. Using specialized ML models and a longitudinal history of WaveZip files, we're able to surface proactive insights never possible before. With these and other tools across the chip design stack, we’ll own the observability layer every person and agent will need for chip design.

name: Hebbian Robotics
one_liner: Foundational infrastructure for Physical AI
physical_hits: Robotics; Physical AI; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description: Hebbian Robotics builds open source foundational infrastructure for Physical AI to develop robots that extend what humanity can do, for the benefit of the communities they serve.

name: HERA
one_liner: Agents for Industrials
long_description: At Hera, we build physical AI tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.

name: Hilstart
one_liner: Autonomous Hardware Testing
long_description: We build physical agent harnesses to enable AI to debug, validate, and ship functional hardware and software.

name: Hop Aero
one_liner: Rocket cargo delivery to contested environments
long_description: Hop Aero is building rocket cargo vehicles that deliver to contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes. Our rockets fly point-to-point into the most austere locations at hypersonic speeds. Hop Aero's goal is to provide the U.S. and allies the asymmetric advantage that deters a future major conflict.

name: Hoplite
one_liner: Effortlessly deploy cloud software factories.

name: Hubble
one_liner: AI-native retrieval engine for medical records
long_description:
Hubble’s mission is to unify the patient medical record and remove the barriers to accessing it. Today, a person’s health history is scattered across disconnected systems, leaving patients and the people helping them to piece it together. We’re building a future where one authorization unlocks a more complete record, regardless of where someone received care. 
 
Our founders previously built healthcare and AI products at Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, and we’re backed by Y Combinator, Madrona, and Basis Set. We’re building our team in Seattle, with the opportunity to work directly with the founders and shape how people access and use their health information.

name: HyperProbe
one_liner: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime
long_description:
With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data. 
 
HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs. 
 
Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. 
 
We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.

name: Illume Labs
one_liner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion
long_description: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.

name: IMPACT Drones
one_liner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
long_description: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.

name: Induction Labs
one_liner: Building intellectually curious AI
long_description:
We are scaling foundation models that are curious about the world. 
 
We’ve seen general intelligence appear exactly once, and its hallmark has been curiosity: a dissatisfaction with what we already know about the world, an ability to learn from world experience, and a disposition to share knowledge with other individuals. Across generations, these human traits have built modern science, technology, and culture. 
 
We think superintelligence will come from models that work the same way: learning from their own observation, updating as they go, growing what they know. These models will start from what humanity knows and discover past us. 
 
We believe that scaling curious intelligence is a defining problem of our time. If solved, we will live to see a new era of technological advances, scientific understanding, and human flourishing.

name: Inkbox
one_liner: Give agents a computer with their own email, phone, iMsg, and WhatsApp
long_description: Give your agents a computer to run on, with their own email, phone, iMessage, and WhatsApp. Each agent runs next to its communication channels, so it never misses a reply, and sleeps when idle, so customers don’t pay for downtime.

name: Insurf
one_liner: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
long_description: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.

name: Isengard Industries Inc
one_liner: Mass-produced AI strike systems and Counter-UAS
long_description:
Isengard Industries is not another drone company. 
 
We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge. 
 
We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age. 
 
More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.

name: Jcode
one_liner: High performance coding agents
long_description: Jcode is a high-performance coding-agent harness that makes it possible for developers to scale up multi-agent/swarm workflows. It's built from the ground up with a different architecture to solve the memory bottleneck (it's 20x more memory efficient than Claude Code) that has kept agent swarms from going mainstream. It has 20K GitHub stars, and throughputs $1mil per month of inference spend

name: Kara
one_liner: Making Diamond Semiconductors
long_description:
Kara is building diamond semiconductors.  
 
We begin with ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat exceptionally well, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably.  
 
Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

name: Kebra
one_liner: AI For The Skilled Workforce
long_description:
Kebra builds AI for skilled technicians. 
 
Kebra guides technicians in the field in real time, documents their job, and automatically handles hours of back-office work; from dispatching technicians to filing warranty claims and managing inventory.

name: Lamb Labs
one_liner: Lightning fast chips with hardcoded AI models
long_description: Lamb Labs is building Model Processing Units (MPUs), custom AI chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into silicon. Rather than adapting general-purpose processors to run AI models, we're rethinking how LLMs are implemented in hardware to make inference dramatically faster and more energy-efficient.

name: LATO
one_liner: Predict how market participants behave
long_description:
LATO is the agent-native research and simulation system that lets investors and companies test any thesis. Funds managing $500bn+ use LATO along with their portfolio companies. 
 
We’re backed by leading funds including Y Combinator, Air Street Capital and Axiom Partners. Our angels include Paul Graham and co-founders of Vercel, ElevenLabs, Snowflake and Rogo. LATO was founded by a former private equity investor and an AI/ML engineer.

name: LemonLime
one_liner: Fully automated growth for small business
long_description:
LemonLime runs fully automated sales and marketing for small businesses. 
 
Every morning, LemonLime finds you new leads and drafts personalized outreach, prepares branded content, and identifies untapped sales & marketing opportunities. 
 
All you have to do is click send.

name: Levocred AI
one_liner: AI Workforce for lenders
long_description: Levocred AI build AI employees for lenders including credit funds, fintechs, credit unions & banks to automate operations like servicing/collections, underwriting, back-office tasks etc.

name: Litmus
one_liner: Evals for humans
long_description:
At Litmus, we’re building evals for humans and redefining how talent is evaluated. Teams like Mercor, Wispr, Composio, Neo Scholars, Astranis, and more are already using Litmus to build their technical teams. 
 
Every company in the world will soon be powered by neo-humans (agent assisted people). But building evals to measure neo-human performance is unexplored and difficult. It requires systematically benchmarking neo-human capabilities and failure modes across all sectors of knowledge work, developing reproducible environments that test neo-human performance on complex tasks, and designing causal attribution frameworks over execution trajectories to identify and validate reproducible action sequences and decision patterns that lead to successful outcomes. 
 
At Litmus, we’re solving this problem. We deliver hiring insights to companies by capturing how candidates use tools, reason, and make decisions in their interviews, giving agentic graders the evidence to evaluate candidate skillset and predict job performance.

name: Locke
one_liner: The First AI Government Affairs Firm.
long_description:
Locke is the first AI-native government affairs firm. 
 
We pair elite lobbyists and political talent with our own AI systems, helping companies lobby policymakers and win government contracts. 
 
Locke's team comes from The White House, Congress, and the Pentagon.

name: Luca IQ
one_liner: API-first tax engine for CPA firms and developers
long_description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.

name: Lumeria
one_liner: Oura Ring for Skin
long_description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.

name: machine0
one_liner: AWS for Agents
agent_hits: Agents; agent; agent; Agents; Agent; agent; agents; agents
long_description:
machine0 is a CLI for agent compute: `machine0 new mybox` gives your agent a full cloud VM, billed by the minute, from small up to 60 vCPU / 240 GB and 8×H100s. Agents drive it themselves via CLI or MCP. 
 
Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent working on a hard feature runs 6-8 hours. Auto-research agents run for days. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.

name: Magma
one_liner: Monetize your agent's traces.
long_description: We enable companies monetize their agents' traces.

name: Maingen
one_liner: Simulating Agents Running Industrial Companies
long_description: Maingen builds simulations for industrial operations ($5 trillion slice of the US economy) so frontier labs can train models that actually run power plants, factories, and datacenters.

name: Manifold
one_liner: Drop-in robotic labor that works on Day 1
long_description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate.  
 
Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot.  
 
Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.

name: Marble
one_liner: The autonomous back-of-house for restaurants.
ai_core_hits: AI; ML; computer vision; ML models
long_description:
Marble is the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house.  
 
Restaurants, cafes and bars still run on a patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets, clipboards and tribal knowledge, which costs the industry billions each year in stockouts, food waste, and lost profit.  
 
Marble replaces that entire stack with one system. Voice AI and computer vision capture real-time inventory levels 90% faster than manual counts, ML models forecast item-level demand at 97% accuracy, and AI agents run dozens of end-to-end workflows autonomously, from procurement and invoice reconciliation to scheduling, food prep, menu engineering, and more.

name: Marengo
one_liner: AI-Native Engineering Firm designing Data Centers
long_description:
Marengo is the AI-native engineering firm automating engineering design, starting with data centers. We’ve generated $70K in revenue in our first month, with $4M in contracts to deliver. 
 
Marengo is backed by YC, Exor, Future Planet Capital, undisclosed $2B AUM family office, and other top-tier investors. 
 
Our team includes the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.

name: Marker
one_liner: Platform + FDEs that rebuild enterprises agent-first
long_description: Marker is a platform for rebuilding enterprises agent-first, delivered by forward-deployed engineers. It productizes every step from discovery to production, so every agent we ship makes the next one faster.

name: Markov
one_liner: The data lab for engineering and computer-use AI.
long_description:
Markov is the data lab for engineering and computer-use AI. We capture real work from domain experts and craft high-fidelity datasets and RL environments. 
 
We built the most complex tasks and RL environments sourced through manufacturing experts proficient in AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, Revit, Siemens NX and more. Our computer-use datasets are action-labelled, narrated and sourced from domain experts in design and enterprise software. 
 
We work with frontier AI labs and we've built over 10,000 CAD environments and collected over 500,000 hours of computer-use data. Our open-source datasets have 800,000+ downloads on Hugging Face.

name: Mass Magnetics
one_liner: USA-made magnetics for robotics and defense.
long_description:
Mass Magnetics turns recycled rare-earth scrap into high-performance permanent magnets, made in America. The materials we supply are the backbone of electric motors, sensors, speakers, hard drives, and electronics. 
Our process enables DFARS-compliant magnets for defense, aerospace, and industrial manufacturers who demand domestic supply without compromising on quality. 
Operations in Greater Boston, MA (Greentown Labs) and Columbus, IN.

name: Mentlio
one_liner: Engineering Intelligence and Token Optimization for the AI-Coding Era
long_description: Mentlio an applied research lab focused on optimizing AI ROI for the modern enterprise. We help engineering teams draw a line between their AI spend and delivery, per engineer. We then cut ~30% of AI spend via Mentlio's custom ML-based intelligent routing, context optimization, and prompt compression.

name: Meteoric
one_liner: Drones that clear clouds over solar farms and weaken hurricanes
long_description: Meteoric is building drones that clear clouds over solar farms and ultimately weaken severe storms and hurricanes.

name: Mireye
one_liner: Search Engine for the Physical World
long_description:
AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it.  
 
Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex. 
 
Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools. 
 
Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

name: Mochi
one_liner: Watch and create anime
long_description: We're the #1 app for AI anime, where fans make the stories. In just 2 months, we’ve grown to 20K+ creators publishing 2K+ series a month, with originals from Marvel, Toei, and Webtoon writers. To date we’ve crossed 300M views on socials.

name: Molagri
one_liner: Resistance free pesticides.
long_description:
Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture. 
 
We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use. 
 
Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.

name: Moonshot
one_liner: agents for the rest of us
long_description:
We want to bring AI agents to a billion people. 
 
To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector. 
 
Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life. 
 
For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot. 
 
Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable. 
 
Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf. 
 
Take life personally. 
 
The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail. 
 
Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team. 
 
Let's make it a Moonshot.

name: Mosaic
one_liner: Defining the frontier of multiplayer AI.
long_description:
Mosaic gives teams and their coding agents shared memory across every session, so everyone can understand what happened, why decisions were made, and pick up where someone else left off. 
 
We started as a real-time coding environment where multiple people and their agents can work together live. It went viral, defined the multiplayer AI category, and inspired frontier labs like Anthropic. 
 
Together, we’re building the infrastructure for people and agents to share context and work together.

name: Most Robotic
one_liner: Research lab building the most robotic household in the world
physical_hits: robotic; physical AI; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description:
We're a robotics research lab pushing what's possible with physical AI. 
 
We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with robotics research backgrounds and industry experience at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

name: Moving Atoms
one_liner: Scan to 3D Model
long_description:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics.  
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it. 
This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive. 
In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.

name: MusicArena
one_liner: The crowdsourced benchmark for AI-generated music and music production
long_description: https://musicarena.io/

name: NebuSec
one_liner: Autonomous AI defense system for cyber attack
long_description:
NebuSec is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team. 
 
We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser. 
 
“Audited by NebuSec” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world’s best hackers.

name: Neuromorphic
one_liner: Building robots to automate wetlabs
long_description: We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!

name: Neuron Industries
one_liner: Industrial Controllers built for AI
long_description: Neuron is crafting the world’s first purpose-built industrial controller for AI, replacing the antiquated PLCs running every machine and factory. We help customers from chemical processing to nuclear reactors compress controls projects from weeks to hours.

name: Nex
one_liner: Grok bot for GTM & Revenue teams
long_description: We build and deploy AI agents that manage prospecting, qualification, CRM hygiene, forecasting, lead routing, revenue recovery, and all the complex revenue work in between, on autopilot.

name: Nori
one_liner: The most capable American-made humanoid robot for $1,688
physical_hits: robot; humanoid; manipulator; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description:
We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business.  
 
Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter. 
 
Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have over $440k+ in sales. 
 
We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it before. name: Olam Labs

long_description:
Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis. 
 
We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions.

Omanta brings context and clarity to complex cases, helping clinicians see more of the scientific picture as they decide how best to care for their patients.

name: OneCLI

long_description:
OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations.

long_description: OpenTag is an AI coworker in your Slack with full context on your company. It answers questions and takes real work off your plate. It also keeps your wiki up to date automatically, so knowledge never goes stale.

name: OpenVector
one_liner: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision
ai_core_hits: AI; language model; vision-language; model inference; inference engine

We've built the world's fastest vision-language model inference engine that allows users to simply describe a task in plain English and automatically build a custom AI vision model to monitor their feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. name: Orchestra
one_liner: Self-optimizing neocloud that cuts LLM costs by 100x
long_description:
Orchestra is an inference cloud. We capture your AI work traces, train smaller models, and automatically deploy them (only when they outperform the expensive model you are currently paying for). 
 
Instead of renting the same frontier model forever, your AI infrastructure gets faster, smarter, and cheaper every time it runs. 
 
Suppose your product uses Claude for a repetitive legal workflow. 
 
Orchestra observes successful production runs, learns the specific tools and judgment required for that workflow, and trains a specialized open-weight model. 
 
Once that model matches or beats Claude on a held-out evaluation, Orchestra starts routing production traffic to it. 
 
As more work is completed, the model keeps improving. 
 
We started Orchestra because we believe every company using AI should be accumulating intelligence, not accumulating API bills.

name: Orikata Bio PBC
one_liner: A multiplayer discovery workspace for human and agentic scientists
ai_core_hits: language models; neural network; generative model; embedding; model inference; inference engine
agent_hits: agentic; agent; agentic; agents; agents; agent; agent; agent; agents
long_description:
A new agent, tool, or generative model alone doesn’t solve the whole problem for most research questions. Someone still has to assemble the data, work out which methods to use and get the tools and datasets working together. We’re building Noto, a multiplayer discovery workbench for human and agentic scientists, to bring everyone's favorite frontier models, agents, tools, and scientific models into one shared workspace, so that you can focus on making your next discovery, rather than wrestling with your Python environment or finding GPUs. 
 
Plan an experiment, work with its generated data, run an analysis or model, maybe even train a new model, and keep the results in the notebook. We designed Noto so that the inputs, code, methods and results stay connected across local and hosted compute. Both people and agents need to see how a result was produced and build on it. Biology is where we’re starting, with the workbench being built for more general research across many scientific disciplines. 
 
Available now: our first biological analysis tools, hosted model inference, and an initial agent interface. Free usage is available within limits, alongside paid model runs and individual and team plans. Researchers can run sequence and structure analyses and hosted scientific models without provisioning GPUs or maintaining each model’s dependencies. 
 
In development: the full multiplayer notebook and wider agent workflows and integrations. 
 
Orikata Bio Public Benefit Corporation, or Orikata Bio PBC, is the company. We work under two brands: Orikata Bio for biological discovery and Megure Labs for scientific software. 
 
Biological discovery with Orikata Bio 
 
We’re developing Ibuki, a world-model family for biology, to learn how evolution, sequence, structure and function relate and use those relationships to understand and engineer living systems. We’re pretraining our own protein language models, and developing coordinate and multimodal models for prediction, inverse folding, alignment and generative design. Proteins are our starting point; DNA, RNA, small molecules, and other biological modalities are part of the longer-term direction. 
 
Along the way, we assembled Umi, with over 100 billion unique protein sequences, and Sora, with nearly two billion protein structure records. Having that much data only helps if we can organize it, compare it and find the biology relevant to a particular question. We’re building the full-corpus embedding, indexing and customer access that will bring more of those collections into research workflows. 
 
Our key insight was that the fixed substitution tables used to compare biological sequences are the simplest example of a neural network. Replacing them with contextual substitution operators lets us learn how positions correspond, from reference alignments and directly from molecular geometry. Hikoboshi (open source) turns those learned relationships into tools for sequence and structure alignment, search, clustering and many other evolutionary analysis pipelines. 
GitHub: https://github.com/orikata-bio/hikoboshi 
 
Scientific software with Megure Labs 
 
Learning those relationships meant making the alignment calculation itself trainable. Orihime (open source), our differentiable-alignment and structured-attention library, lets neural networks learn through scientific algorithms on CPUs and GPUs. It supplies the training machinery behind our learned alignment methods. 
GitHub: https://github.com/megure-labs/orihime 
 
Running the models efficiently is its own problem. Hataya (private evaluation), our inference engine and compiler for scientific models, turns trained models and their dependencies into standalone CPU and GPU programs, carrying the exact weights, identity and verification evidence with them. We’re building it to make both our models and public scientific models cheaper to run, including through Noto’s hosted service. 
 
Kaname coordinates long-running agent work across every model provider: tasks, compute, permissions, retries and the record of what happened. We’re bringing that coordination and provenance into Noto’s research workflows so work can continue across people, agents and machines. 
 
Researchers can start with a single analysis or hosted model run today. Noto is where we’re bringing them together so an analysis or model run can become part of a continuing research project, with the data, methods and results kept alongside it. 
 
Try Noto’s live tools: https://megure.ai/noto/workspace/ 
Biological tools: https://orikata.ai/tools/ 
Scientific software: https://megure.ai/ 
Biological discovery: https://orikata.ai/ 
Open source: https://github.com/megure-labs and https://github.com/orikata-bio 
For research use, questions about the data or private evaluations: casey@orikata.ai

name: OS3
one_liner: Affordable, intelligent humanoid robots built to deploy at scale
physical_hits: robots; humanoid; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description:
OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business. 
 
Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect.  
 
We built OS3 to solve both. 
 
Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time. 
 
This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford. 
 
Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.

name: Osmaura
one_liner: AI-native client acquisition & care for corporate law firms
long_description:
We surface new client, cross selling, upselling opportunities that a firm is well positioned to take advantage of. We manage the client experience from sourcing to onboarding to future matters. 
 
We're here to help law firms grow and care for their clients while they focus on what they do best. Lawyers are trained to practice law - not to prospect, sell, and manage clients.

name: Osseus

long_description: Osseus is building the frontier biomedical AI research lab, starting with the evaluations, reinforcement learning environments, and datasets that help AI labs train more capable, aligned, and safe models. We post-train models for medical and biological tasks, and deploy these in biotech, pharma and healthcare systems to ultimately improve patient outcomes.

name: Pacific
one_liner: Robotic factories to mass produce data centers
long_description:
We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week. 
 
Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue. 
 
Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert.  
 
We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.

name: Palette

long_description: Palette builds and deploys state-of-the-art generative models for marketing, film, and physical design. Founded by MIT computer scientists and multimodal AI researchers, we're advancing how generative models create, understand, and transform media and the physical world.

name: Prescience, Inc.
one_liner: Superintelligent health insurance that keeps employees healthy
long_description:
Prescience is the preeminent health benefits platform for the world's most ambitious companies. We save employers 20-50% on health insurance while offering best-in-industry health benefits: www.getprescience.com 
 
About us: 
Prescience is building a new healthcare system for America. We train AI systems to: create, operate, insure, and deliver healthcare for employer health plans. name: Prodigy Research
one_liner: Training the world's best AI model for quantitative finance.

Join us as we use AI to solve the market.

name: Proprio Robotics

long_description: Proprio Robotics is building state-of-the-art physical intelligence to automate the entire data center lifecycle—from buildout to maintenance to decommissioning. name: ProvenMetal
one_liner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
long_description:
ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. 
 
Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. 
 
We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.

Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter.

name: Radley
one_liner: The AI-native radiology practice
long_description:
Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up. 
 
Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year. 
 
From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end. 
 
We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.

name: Rapidfolio
one_liner: AI-native back-office for banks and fintechs
long_description:
Rapidfolio helps banks and fintechs fully automate back-office workflows like fraud investigations, KYB/KYC and loan underwriting, with accuracy and auditability. 
 
Built by fintech founders and operators, Rapidfolio is on a mission to ensure banks and fintechs scale their customer base without adding another back-office head count.

name: Rasyn
one_liner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
long_description:
We build foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. 
 
Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. 
 
Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three. 
 
We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.

name: Rational
one_liner: First Zero-human Accounting Firm
long_description: Rational is building the first accounting firm with no humans. It's entirely run by our AI employees, who go from client intake to doing the books to filing with the IRS. We secure 90% cost reduction, 24/7 support, and an overall seamless experience for businesses.

name: RealPact
one_liner: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
long_description:
RealPact builds AI agents that handle the paperwork behind real estate transactions. They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster. 
 
We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated. With today’s advances in AI, we can build agents that handle this operational work and create modern software around how brokerages actually work. 
 
We currently sell to brokerages in New Hampshire and are expanding quickly.

name: rekursiv.ai
one_liner: Scale AI scientists whose own breakthroughs accelerate the next.
long_description:
We're scaling self-improving AI scientist teams to ideate/experiment/discover, generating new knowledge autonomously. Their discoveries reduced ARC-1/2 costs by 10,000× while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy and yielded material advances on combinatorial ML problems. 
 
We believe that AI is bounded not by compute, but ideas. Scaling to millions of sessions of discovery enables leveraging its own discoveries and presents a novel training source capable of ushering a new era of self-reliant foundational models.

name: Rex
one_liner: AI operations partner for enterprise order-to-cash
long_description:
Rex is a managed AI service for AR and order-to-cash. AI agents and finance experts run the work that delays payment, from collections, portals, disputes and remittances to the shared AR inbox, so cash keeps moving. 
 
Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours. 
 
We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour. 
 
Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.

name: Riften
one_liner: Earned intelligence. An independent AI research lab.
long_description:
Riften is an independent AI research lab exploring intelligence in software and the physical world. 
 
We study how models learn and represent knowledge, and build systems that put that research to work. Our work spans model routing, evaluations, post-training, and physical AI. 
 
Earned intelligence.

name: Rindler
one_liner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
long_description:
We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once. 
 
Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing. 
 
Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call. 
 
Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point

name: Rise Reforming
one_liner: We turn waste gases into supply-secure chemicals
tags: Hard Tech|Smart Waste Management|Alternative Fuels|Renewable Energy|ClimateTech
long_description:
Geopolitical conflicts and natural disasters frequently expose the vulnerability of the American chemical industry. The reason? Production is centralized and fossil fuel-dependent. The solution? Localized production using an undervalued resource: biogas. The US produces enough biogas to make over $20 bn/y worth of chemicals, but 60% is wasted in low-margin applications or flared altogether. 
 
Rise Reforming is commercializing a modular process to transform this underutilized biogas on-site into cheap, supply-secure chemicals. Our beachhead market is dimethyl ether (DME), used as an aerosol propellant and a low-carbon fuel additive in propane. Our target market is methanol: an established billion $ chemical and the future of low-carbon shipping. 
 
We're doing our pilot project at a Chicagoland wastewater plant. This will be the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demo in the Americas. 
 
We're hiring for a senior chemical process engineer. Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rise-reforming/jobs/wJ9Q9nv-senior-chemical-process-engineer

name: Robocurve
one_liner: Evals for robots
long_description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust. 
 
Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits. 
 
Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once. 
 
Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.

name: RonanRx Inc.
one_liner: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
long_description:
RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s. 
 
In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week. 
 
We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive. 
 
What makes this possible is AI. 
 
Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose. 
 
Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient. 
 
Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time. 
 
Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible. 
 
We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them. 
 
Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie. 
 
We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.

name: Salem Robotics Inc

They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. name: Shielded
one_liner: We help Fortune 500 companies hedge their supply chain risk
long_description: Shielded connects companies’ internal and external data to map market shifts, tariffs, and disruptions directly to suppliers, products, and margins. We turn those impacts into real-time decisions that grow and protect the business.

name: Shiraz AI
one_liner: Robots that learn on the job
physical_hits: Robots; manipulation; VLAs; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description:
We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over. 
 
Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

name: Sidekick
one_liner: AI agent that manages manufacturing operations over text
long_description:
Sidekick is an AI agent that runs custom manufacturing operations over text. Workers text a problem, photo, video, or voice memo and get an answer from the shop's own documents. It reads live machine data and acts on its own: flagging issues before they become downtime, opening and routing work orders, and placing purchase orders. No app, no login. 
 
These shops run on tribal knowledge: a handful of veterans know how every job is set up, and they are retiring. Sidekick learns from every message it handles, so answers outlive the people who gave them, and shops run 15% more jobs with the same crew. Sidekick captures it as a byproduct of the work, in an industry that was never documented.

name: Skymerse
one_liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations
long_description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.

name: Snowstone
one_liner: AI-Driven Value Creation and Margin Expansion for Private Equity
long_description: Snowstone helps private equity firms drive operational value creation with AI. It's like a performance improvement engagement from a top consulting firm, but built from the company's own data, delivered in one week, and with every finding traced to its source. Today, private equity firms rely on consultants to find where portfolio companies can improve. That work depends on interviews and data requests, so the conclusions are secondhand, biased by internal politics and hard to check. Snowstone goes straight to the source data. It analyzes how a portfolio company actually operates and identifies automation potential, duplicated work, process bottlenecks and key-person risk, each quantified by its EBITDA impact.

name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
one_liner: AI-native procurement services for the physical economy
long_description: SpaceFlow is an AI-native procurement services company for businesses that make, move and serve physical goods. We help procurement teams bring more spend under management, execute source-to-contract work and turn identified savings into realized savings without adding headcount or replacing existing systems.

name: Spectre Intelligence
one_liner: We are a multi-strategy trading firm that trains AI traders.
long_description: Spectre Intelligence is a neotrading firm. We create AI traders instead of hiring human ones. Currently trading semis + bio.

name: Speko
one_liner: AI Phone Agents for Business Calls
long_description: Speko is a voice agent platform for business phone calls: teams build, test, run and monitor AI phone agents for scripted calls such as interviews, candidate screens and intake. Use cases include hiring screens, clinic intake, customer support and appointment booking. Simulated callers test each draft, and an AI judge reviews each call. Free credit on signup, no sales call needed. Speko is audited for SOC 2 Type 2 and compliant with HIPAA and GDPR. Speko is based in San Francisco (YC S26).

name: Standard Machines
one_liner: Automating Chip Design
long_description: We're a new kind of chip company focused on autonomy.

name: Stoa
