long_description: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.

name: Studio
one_liner: Accurately simulate market response at scale
long_description: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior data. Our simulations match live KPI outcomes like revenue and purchase behavior with over 97% accuracy for consumer-facing enterprises, higher than any synthetic panel, simulation lab, or traditional market research.

name: SubVysion
one_liner: Autonomous rovers to make the ‘Google Maps’ of underground utilities
long_description: We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.

name: Sunflower
one_liner: We are building an AI-native telemedicine clinic for addiction. 🌻
long_description:
Sunflower is building an AI-native telemedicine clinic for addiction. There are over 18,750 patients on a waitlist for Therapy or Meds, representing $153M worth of TAM just waiting to be served.  
 
We started by launching Sunflower Sober, the first AI Sponsor for addiction which grew to 100 MAU in less than 6 months and currently driving about $1.5M in run-rate worth of subscription app revenue.   
 
Sunflower Sober is currently pacing to add over 800,000 new users a year which means we are growing literally faster than Alcoholics Anonymous.  
 
We have built one of the largest and most deeply loved brands within sobriety, and now we are building the clinical services underneath this brand to better fulfill on our mission & serve Medicaid who spends over $30B a year on SUD services.  
 
Sunflower is founded by Koby who previously led Growth at Rupa from $5M to $75M/year. Our team includes clinical leaders (MDs / LPCs) from the Mayo Clinic, Choose Your Horizon, & Charlie Health.

name: Synapse Semiconductor
one_liner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
long_description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go.  
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

name: TareBio
one_liner: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks.
long_description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.

name: Tarifflo Inc.
one_liner: Supply chain compliance and cost savings
long_description:
Tarifflo is the modern ABI, built for the AI agent era. 
 
Legacy ABI software was built for people keying entries into screens. Tarifflo is built for code and agents. Every part of customs work is an API call: create entries from documents, classify every line to HTS, fill PGA records, apply Chapter 99 duties, transmit to CBP and track status through liquidation. 
 
Your agents can file customs. Connect Claude or any MCP client and it prepares full entries using the same API. You review and approve, and Tarifflo files under your own filer code. Developers get REST and webhooks. Everyone gets one key, one meter and one bill. 
 
Under it all is the same engine: live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion and rate change. The duty you file going forward is as right as the duty we audit looking back. 1 in 8 products we audit is overpaying, and if you overpaid on past entries we find it and file for your refund.

name: tash
one_liner: The S&P of Trading Cards
long_description:
tash is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards. 
 
Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.

name: Tenor
one_liner: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native businesses.
long_description: Tenor is a full-stack infrastructure for building and running AI-native businesses. We’re not just an agent framework, we manage the entire loop from how AI executes work to how every action, decision, and business outcome is captured and learned from. Owning the full stack lets companies deploy governed AI workflows, understand what actually drives results, and continuously improve how their business operates without building the infrastructure themselves.

name: Tensr
one_liner: Robotic factories that build robots
long_description:
Robotic factories that build robotics in the US. Currently operating a 12,000 sqft factory in the Bay Area and actively manufacturing customer orders for some of the largest robotics companies in the US and the International Space Station. 
 
We’re a group of Berkeley graduate robotics researchers who previously won a full scale autonomous IndyCar competition at 160mph.

name: Tokenless
one_liner: We find flaws in RL environments and evals and help you fix them.
long_description:
Tokenless is an applied AI research lab. Our goal is to end reward hacking. We do research and build tools to detect issues with environments and evals, understand model behavior in those environments, and prevent those issues from happening. Correcting them makes training more effective, makes model performance easier to interpret, and is crucial to solving the AI alignment problem. 
 
If you’re training models with RL, building environments, or running agent evals, and want more confidence in your environments, we're here to help.

name: Torus
one_liner: Superintelligence for Infrastructure
long_description:
Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West.  
 
We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.

name: Touchmark
one_liner: Market for future inference capacity
long_description: Buy tokens over a time window from the provider of your choice at a price fixed today - 10-30% off the on-demand price. If your plans change - resell your reserved capacity to another buyer.

name: TovenAI
one_liner: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms
long_description:
TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage. 
 
With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.

name: Traceforce
one_liner: CrowdStrike for AI Agents
long_description:
AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up. 
 
Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.

name: Tracer
one_liner: Combining open-source AI models for better answers at lower cost
long_description:
Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model.

Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.

name: Trident
one_liner: Autonomous offensive security agents. The best defense is offense
long_description:
Trident is the standard for modern day security. its an agentic pentester that chains vulnerabilities together like a real attacker mapping verified attack paths across AWS, Azure, GCP, web apps, and APIs. Run AI attacks and get fixes. 
 
Get started today: tridentsecurity.io

name: Trope
one_liner: AI FDE that deploys custom AI agents into ERPs
long_description: Trope deploys custom AI agents into ERPs for mid-market companies. Every ERP is heavily customized, so useful agents need custom deployment too. Trope’s AI FDE learns each business and ERP, then builds and deploys agents, turning the last mile from services into software.

name: TryNearby
one_liner: Local creators for local businesses
long_description: TryNearby connects local businesses with creators who live nearby. Restaurants subscribe monthly and automatically get booked visits from local creators who film, edit, and post a review to the local algorithm. This creates a steady stream of content that compounds into discovery on TikTok, Instagram, and increasingly AI search. Over 100 restaurants and thousands of creators are on the platform across Southern California, with AI agents handling matching, booking, and every creator conversation.

name: Tsenta
one_liner: AI career agent that finds matching jobs & applies on your behalf
long_description:
Tsenta is an AI career agent that matches you with jobs, applies automatically, and gets you the best offers on the market. 
 
We grew to ~$3M Annualized in three months.  
 
We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so that candidates would always have someone on their side. 
 
Today, more than 90,000+ job seekers trust Tsenta to automate their job search.

name: Ultrasonium
one_liner: Metal manufacturing, faster, cheaper, and more versatile.
physical_hits: robots; physical AI; satellites; rockets; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description:
The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous. 
 
Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes.  
 
The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority. 
 
Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.

name: Verdant
one_liner: AI Agents to Make Local Gov Efficient
long_description:
Verdant sells AI agents to local government to make them more efficient. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgment.  
 
Many startups fail to sell to government, but not us - we've processed 200+ applications and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states with an average close time of 4 weeks.

name: Verdict Machine
one_liner: AI cybersecurity for financial institutions' digital assets
long_description:
Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies.

In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks.

The founding team launched and led blockchain security at Check Point (NASDAQ: CHKP).

name: Vernius Systems, Inc.
one_liner: Mass-deployable radars for air defense
long_description:
We make mass-deployable radars for unmanned systems. Our first product is Archimedes, a radar seeker that finds and locks onto targets, enabling autonomous intercept on any drone. We have over $580M in LOIs for Archimedes, across some of the largest defense primes in Ukraine, the EU, and the Middle East. 
 
Seekers are the most critical and costly component in every autonomous interceptor. Developing a radar seeker takes a 200+ person team at Raytheon and hundreds of millions of dollars. Archimedes is 100x cheaper than existing radar seekers on the market - and is the first product to make it feasible to deploy radars on every drone.

name: Vestris
one_liner: The FICO score for homes
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
long_description: With the government pushing to make title insurance optional on refinances, lenders are starting to take on title risk. Vestris gives every property a risk assessment, like a credit score for homes, so lenders know what they're lending against and homeowners know where their property stands.

name: Waddle Labs
one_liner: LLMs that control robots

name: Waybill
one_liner: Agentic procurement & inventory for deep tech teams.
long_description:
Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf. 
 
Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated.  
 
Take your supply chain for granted. 
 
Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).

name: Whitespace
one_liner: AI Operating System for Wholesale Distribution
long_description:
Whitespace builds AI agents that run the entire operation of supply chain businesses, starting with wholesale distributors. We give them self-improving AI agents that learn their business and do work like inventory planning and customer service. 
 
We're building towards a world where all supply chain operations run through our agents, and all physical goods purchases can happen across businesses without human touch.

name: Wondering
one_liner: Duolingo for learning anything
long_description:
Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises.  
 
Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go. 
 
It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights. 
 
Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download

name: WonderTx
one_liner: Extrapolative AI to unlock First-in-Class drugs
former_names: A Company in Stealth Mode Incorporated
long_description:
We’re an AI-native biotech, working on replacing needles with pills. Many drugs, like insulin or Ozempic, are wonderful except you have to inject them. We discover new molecules that you can take as a pill instead. Because the pills operate on biology which has been shown to be effective in people, rather than merely in animal models of disease, we avoid what has historically been the single biggest risk in drug discovery.  This should dramatically increase our probability of success. 
 
There’s $200B of treatable diseases and validated human biology without a pill because discovery programs lack a tractable chemical starting point. This is a zero-shot inference problem, because these targets have no training data, so LLMs and other historical interpolative AI approaches are insufficient. Instead, we are building our own extrapolative frontier models that reason beyond their training data. Most critically, we have repeatedly validated our platform on both our own and partner programs. On 4 biologically- and structurally-diverse targets where we had zero training data, we successfully picked binders that were validated experimentally, with confirmation ranging from primary screen hits to crystallographic structures.

name: Zaplar
one_liner: Agentic Hotel Operating System
long_description:
Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels. 
 
Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously. 
 
Learn more at https://zaplar.com

name: Zomma
one_liner: The AI BPO for financial servies, run by computer-use agents
long_description: Zomma is building the AI workforce for financial services with computer-use agents that onboard like humans and scale like compute. Its agents handle KYC reviews, transaction alerts, and disputes on the same screens human analysts use, no integration.

name: 0.security
one_liner: Sovereign AI security agents for enterprise
long_description:
0.security helps software companies, large enterprises and critical infrastructure providers find & fix security risks. With our open-source software infrastructure, enterprises can build & deploy AI security agents in their own environments with full control over their data and operations. 
 
We just passed 1.5k GitHub stars, including engineers at Spotify, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Google, Wiz, Red Hat, Mistral AI, and Dan Guido (CEO Trail of Bits). Our agents have found & fixed 30+ previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in the Linux kernel, which runs on 3B+ devices, and 500+ CVEs including in government code from multiple countries. We work with critical infrastructure providers, large enterprise and are partnered with EY and defense organizations 
 
Most AI security tools are cloud-based black boxes that enterprises can’t safely deploy across sensitive infrastructure. We solve this with open-source, self-hosted agents. Engineers adopt us for free, and enterprises pay to deploy and manage agents across their environments. 
 
Global cybersecurity spending is projected to exceed $300 billion in 2026. We start with critical infrastructure providers, then expand across enterprise security workflows. 
 
Both founders have built companies, won startup awards, and competed at the highest national level in sports. Doruk led Cyber & Autonomous Systems for the Swiss Mars Rover Team and co-founded Soothe Studios. Fabian co-founded the institutional quant fund Mellivora Capital and helped grow Crypto Finance (acq. by Deutsche Börse Group) from 10 to 100+ employees. Doruk is a former Swiss table tennis champion & trainer; Fabian is a former Swiss trampoline gymnastics champion.

name: Acyclic Labs
one_liner: Benchmarks, RL envs and infra for scaling agent swarms
long_description:
We’re building the foundations of agent swarms that can materially accelerate all work: benchmarks to measure model capabilities, models trained to coordinate thousands of agents, RL environments to improve them, and infrastructure that can put a datacenter’s worth of compute behind a single conversation within seconds. 
 
Both founders graduated top 10% from Cambridge. Ram is a published ML researcher and Varun worked at the frontier of parallel programming languages and shipped enterprise multi-agent systems at Palantir and Tracelight. We realised that agents were good enough to solve most use cases. So why couldn’t we run thousands of them at once and finish hours of work in minutes?

name: Adalat AI
one_liner: AI OS transforming courts, accelerating justice

name: Adside.ai
one_liner: AI agency that manages paid ads on Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.
long_description: We're Robin Choy and Guillaume Miara, founders of Adside (adside.ai). We're building Adside, a swarm of agents that manages ads on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, etc. We’re building the service we wished we had in our previous B2B marketing software company that we sold earlier this year.

name: Agent 37
one_liner: Cheapest sandbox for AI agents
agent_hits: agents; Agent; agents; agent; agent; Agents; agents
long_description:
Agent 37 builds the cheapest sandboxes for running AI agents. 
 
A sandbox is the cloud computer an agent runs in. Every agent needs its own computer to keep its files and run code.  
 
Agents are going to vastly outnumber humans, and sandboxes today are too expensive to run at that scale. Ours cost 94% less than most sandbox providers, and you pay by the minute, for the time your agents run.

name: Agent Relay
one_liner: Let your teams' coding agents message each other
agent_hits: agents; Agent; agents; agents; agent; agent; agents; agent; agent; Agents; agent; agent
long_description:
Agent Relay lets software teams' AI coding agents message each other directly, so people stop copy/pasting between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and their teammates' agents. A frontend agent can ask the backend agent what an API returns, two agents can sort out a merge conflict between themselves, and your agent can answer a colleague's agent while you sleep. 
  
Agents connect wherever they run: terminals, desktop apps, phones, laptops, cloud boxes, or a Mac mini across the world. Every session goes into shared, searchable history, so decisions don't get stuck in one person's chat. You can even let a customer's agent debug with yours. Setup takes about 5 minutes: give your agent the link and it installs itself. Use our hosted version free, or self-host the open-source version.

name: Ageospatial
one_liner: Physical intelligence for every decision with Geospatial AI.
long_description:
Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using geospatial AI. Some of the largest Banks and Insurance companies use our Geospatial AI Operating System. 
 
insurers price buildings they’ve never seen. banks lend money on land they may never visit. so we take a look using geospatial data. 
 
give us an address or a list of properties. our AI checks satellite images, street photos and public records alongside the customer’s own files. we put what we find in one operating system, with the source behind each finding. 
 
an underwriter can see what a building is used for, what’s on its roof and whether it sits in a flood zone before deciding what premium to charge. a bank can use the same product to check whether a farmer planted the crop it financed, on the land it financed. one insurance company told us they found in seconds what would have taken them hours to look up by hand.

name: Aikido Technologies
one_liner: Offshore datacenters, powered by the wind
long_description: We're building GW-scale datacenters in the ocean where there are no limits to the speed and scale of deployment.  Our proprietary offshore platform structure supports a 15MW+ wind turbine, hours of battery storage, backup diesel power generation and 10+ MW of data halls inside their structure, which can be cooled freely by the ocean.

name: Ailit
one_liner: Electrifying North American freight rail with swappable batteries.
long_description:
Ailit is building the electric energy system for North American freight rail. Our first product, Superwagon, is a battery wagon designed to power existing diesel-electric locomotives, allowing railroads to electrify the fleets they already own. 
 
Superwagon carries swappable battery packs that supply electricity to the locomotive’s existing electric motors. Discharged packs are exchanged for charged ones along the route and recharged off-board, providing operators with limitless range. 
 
We deliver energy as a service, owning and operating the batteries and swapping sites. Railroads pay for energy with no upfront equipment purchase, with pricing set at 20% below today’s diesel cost. 
 
Founded in Stockholm by Christian Lind and Emil Tagesson, our team is now based in San Francisco. We’re building our first full-scale prototype, and it’s being prepared to move a locomotive on battery power in the coming days.

name: Alkera AI
one_liner: AI platform for enterprise data teams
long_description: Alkera is the AI platform for enterprise data teams, especially in regulated industries where trust isn't optional, with governed agents that handle data engineering, analytics, and data science across a company's entire data stack. Our agents connect to every data tool and application a company runs, from legacy to modern, trace end-to-end lineage across all of them, and operate under strict permissions with full observability into everything they touch, while automatically maintaining a shared team context that includes a knowledge base and semantic layer. Our research division backs the product and services with proprietary techniques, including training models on each company's own data, so enterprises own AI efficiently tuned to their data work.

name: Altair Health
one_liner: Stripe for medical billing
long_description:
Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions. 
 
That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers.  
 
Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay. 
 
We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot. 
 
Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on. And to the Health Insurers' "Delay, Deny, Defend", we say "Predict, Prevent, Prevail".

name: Ample Computer
one_liner: The one-stop cloud for agents to ship complex web apps
long_description:
Vibecoding has made creating software easy, but launching a real app still means wiring up 5-10 separate cloud services, which stops most new builders. Ample is the one-stop cloud for agents to ship complex web apps.  
 
Add Ample to Claude or ChatGPT, tell your agent to "deploy on Ample", and get a live URL in seconds. Ample reads your codebase, works out what infrastructure it needs, and sets up compute, database, storage, CDN, domain and email, with payments, text and analytics next. We then monitor, patch and scale your app so you never have to migrate it. 
 
Ravi and Ishan led product and infrastructure engineering for the Shopify App Store, a platform of 25,000 apps used by 5 million merchants and processing $1B in GMV a year. We're doing for software what Shopify did for e-commerce, so that anyone with a computer or even a phone can deploy, share and sell ambitious software from any AI platform.

name: antimattr
one_liner: voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction
long_description:
antimattr is building the hardware interface for human–agent interaction: an AI wearable system made up of a smart ring and voice-isolating earbuds. 
 
Voice is the fastest way to instruct an AI agent, but most people won’t use it in public because it’s noisy and unreliable. We think voice AI adoption is held back by hardware, not by model quality. 
 
The earbuds use our proprietary voice isolation to capture your voice clearly anywhere, whether that’s a loud pub, a factory floor or a busy street. That means clear calls and dictation/transcription you can trust. 
 
The ring is a discreet way to control your agents. Tap to capture a thought, trigger a workflow, or record/summarise a conversation into a searchable personal memory.

name: Antropi Robotics
one_liner: Autonomous factories that turn designs into metal parts, in days

name: AnyAlpha
one_liner: The agentic trading platform
long_description:
AnyAlpha is the agentic trading platform. It turns your trading idea into an agent that trades it for you, 24/7. 
 
Start with an idea. AnyAlpha builds the agent on institutional-grade data, backtests it on historical data, and trades it live on multiple exchanges. We're starting with prediction markets, with more asset classes to follow. 
 
We signed Kalshi’s first and only partnership for agentic trading. AnyAlpha has reached 1,000+ active traders and over $1M in weekly trading volume since we launched trading in October.

name: Anywhere
one_liner: Your places, plans, friends and memories, all on one living map
long_description:
Anywhere is a personal, social map that brings your places, friends, plans, memories, and AI agents together. It gives you one place to discover where to go, organize the places you care about, and remember where you’ve been. 
 
Built by the team behind Zenly, Bump & Life360.

name: Applied Kinetics
one_liner: AI-native manufacturing for data center and energy projects
long_description: Applied Kinetics is an AI-native, end-to-end manufacturer for data center and energy developers. We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. Every unit is built to project specifications, and we manage the process from technical requirements through production and delivery. We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.

name: Archangel Health
one_liner: Infra to make AI safe enough to practice medicine
long_description: Archangel Health builds the infrastructure to post-train and evaluate medical AI: RL environments inside real de-identified EHRs, physician-verified training data, and benchmarks that test clinical reasoning on hard cases. Frontier labs and medical AI companies use it today, and we're now moving toward post-training open-source models for health systems on their own data and their own physicians' judgment

name: Archgen Labs
one_liner: AI-powered EDA tools for faster, cooler 3D chips
long_description:
Archgen Labs builds AI-powered chip design tools for the next generation of 3D semiconductors. 
 
Stacking compute vertically shortens connections and reduces the energy and delay of moving data. But it also makes heat harder to remove. Our tools help engineers optimize placement, timing, and temperature together so they can build faster, more power-efficient 3D chips. 
 
Our GPU-accelerated placement engine ranked first in the Hudson River Trading macro-placement challenge. LayerTherm, our thermal analysis tool, predicts chip temperatures roughly 5,000× faster than conventional simulation in our benchmarks, helping engineers explore more designs and identify hotspots earlier. Newton, our AI chip design engineer, automates work across placement, routing, design-rule fixes, and timing closure. 
 
We’re working with GlobalFoundries on 3D chip development, targeting our first tapeout in 2027.

name: Armorer Labs
one_liner: Continuous security verification for AI in regulated industries
long_description:
Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI systems faster and keep them secure in production. 
 
Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours. 
 
In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action. 
 
Armorer's detection models beat every other detector we tested on six public benchmarks. Armorer is 22% more accurate than JEV while being 88x faster, so users won't feel the delay. 
 
We spent years building and evaluating AI security systems together at AWS, including its first customer-facing AI security agent, which scaled to 100k+ customers. Armorer is backed by Paul Vixie, an internet pioneer inducted into the Internet Hall of Fame in 2014.

name: Asakana
one_liner: Automating away manual admin for food distributors: texts to ERP
long_description: Restaurants send orders to food distributors by email, text, and photo. Someone at the distributor retypes every one of them into the ERP. Asakana does that entry instead: orders land in the ERP already entered, and anything unclear goes to a person before it goes in. Live at US seafood distributors today, returning 40%+ of order-desk time to selling. Founded by a seafood distributor and a Gemini builder.

name: Ascenix
one_liner: Custom software for senior care facilities.
long_description:
Ascenix is building one custom interface for running senior homes. We combine reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home's existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team. 
 
Living in a retirement home convinced us that the best way to improve residents' lives is to improve the systems staff rely on. As the older population grows, care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away. Disconnected products that solve each of these individually add costs and leave staff moving information between systems. 
 
Our building blocks gather information from EHRs like PointClickCare and other sources, process it, apply rules, and produce reports, tasks, or emails. Incident reporting and reimbursement reviews usually come from two separate vendors. Ascenix builds both from the same blocks, in one interface, so data isn't stuck in silos. Homes start with their biggest bottleneck and add workflows as priorities change.

name: Asim
one_liner: Enable robots to operate safely in the real world.
long_description:
Asim is building standardized benchmarks for physical intelligence, helping robotics companies understand their robots’ capabilities and safety limits before deployment. 
We test real robots under changing physical conditions, varying shape, weight, friction and material, to identify where performance breaks down and give engineers actionable feedback. 
 
Our four founders include three PhD researchers, two specializing in robotics, with backgrounds at Sony and NASA JPL and two RoboCup@Home championship wins. 
 
Our ambition is to become the standard robotics teams use to measure progress and assess readiness for deployment.

name: Aucert
one_liner: Expert AI agents that explore, understand, and verify mobile apps.
long_description:
AI made building apps fast. Verifying did not keep up: every mobile team, from a first release to a billion downloads, still waits on QA, design, accessibility, compliance and security checks for everything it builds. 
 
Aucert is a team of expert AI agents that does that work in hours, with no scripts. Each agent explores the app on its own, learns how it should work, and finds the issues in its area. Aucert plugs into agentic coding workflows, so developers and coding agents fix issues in the same loop, on every build. 
 
Live: Accessibility · Google Play policy 
Beta: Validation (functional QA) · Design 
Coming soon: Apple App Store policy · Security · Create your own

name: Audora
one_liner: Audiobooks where every character has their own voice.
long_description:
Audora turns your book or story into an audiobook where every character has their own voice. 
 
The best adaptation of a book is the one in your head. You can see the characters in front of you and hear them talking to each other. We want an audiobook to do those characters justice: a voice that fits each of them, so a conversation actually sounds like a conversation. 
 
Paste a story link or upload a file. Audora works out who’s speaking and gives each character a distinct voice alongside the narrator. You can start listening while the rest of the book is still being made. 
 
Our roots are in fanfiction. We’re building for readers who already know these characters by heart, with a focus on voices that capture their personalities and stay consistent throughout the story. 
 
Try Audora: https://audora.art 
Watch the demo: https://youtu.be/R6Pt2O0fD4c

name: Aviern
one_liner: Unmanned cargo airplanes
long_description: Aviern makes unmanned cargo airplanes for commercial operations and defense logistics. In 2 months we built our own scaled aircraft that taxis, takes off, flies and lands fully autonomously and are working on a larger 50lb aircraft.

name: Avout
one_liner: Avout - new finance company for the American frontier
long_description:
Avout provides non-dilutive financing to companies building in the physical world: robotics, space, drones, autonomy, and AI infrastructure & data. 
 
Hardware companies need capital for equipment, inventory, and production long before revenue catches up. Today they fund it with venture equity, the most expensive money they'll ever raise, because banks don't understand the assets or move at startup speed. 
 
We're starting with asset-backed lending and revenue-based financing, using a company's own operating data to make decisions quickly. Our vision is to become the financial rails for the machine economy. 
 
We've done this before with real assets. Artem Milinchuk founded FarmTogether (YC W'18 accepted), a farmland investment platform he scaled to $220M in assets across 50 farms, and previously invested at Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan and was CFO at Full Harvest. Cofounder Cody DeVilliers built banking and payments infrastructure at Interac, Moneris, and TD Bank.

name: Axiomat
one_liner: AI that never hallucinates.
long_description:
Axiomat makes it impossible for AI agents to make mistakes when querying a company’s data. It formally verifies that the agents’ queries are correct before employees or customers rely on the answers.  
 
It is becoming increasingly important for companies to rely on AI without the need for humans to manually check the answers. This has created a need for systems which can guarantee correctness without limiting the agent’s capabilities. Axiomat provides the infrastructure to prove that answers are correct, starting with data queries and analysis. It brings mathematical guarantees to the agents working with your data. 
 
The team brings direct experience solving AI hallucinations through Ethan’s work as an Applied Scientist at AWS, where he worked on formally verifying AI responses. They also bring research experience in AI, LLMs, and formal methods from EPFL, the University of Toronto, and Georgia Tech.

name: Axonnic
one_liner: Creating human skill at robot scale
long_description: Axonnic is building the missing data layer for dexterous robotics. Our wearable EMG technology captures human intent, effort and force directly from muscle activity as people demonstrate physical tasks. By revealing the physical signals that video cannot capture, Axonnic gives AI models the data they need to learn more precise and dexterous behaviour. Beyond robotics, this creates a foundation for new forms of human–computer interaction in which technology can understand and respond directly to human movement and intent.

name: Bayworks
one_liner: Intelligence that keeps America’s vehicles running
long_description:
Bayworks is building the intelligence that runs vehicle repair. We capture how expert technicians diagnose and fix cars, then use that knowledge to guide every technician in real time and run the back office on autopilot. 
 
In four months, we have gone from zero to almost seven figures in cARR, across 6 dealership groups including a top-50 US dealer ($3Bn annual revenue), and have powered over 50,000 repairs. 
 
This becomes the default system for vehicle repair, where dealerships, car manufacturers, insurers and warranty providers transact. Every repair we capture builds the knowledge to eventually direct robots to perform the repairs themselves.

name: BioDelivera
one_liner: Programmable drug delivery precisely targets only diseased cells
long_description: BioDelivera has developed proprietary GCV™, a drug delivery platform designed to travel through the body and selectively target diseased cells while sparing healthy ones. GCVs can carry genetic medicines, DNA, RNA, small molecules, or combinations of these at the same time. BioDelivera has demonstrated efficacy in tumors, muscle, and brain and is expanding to additional tissues. The company’s mission is to enable cures for every patient, across every disease.

name: Biomes
one_liner: Deploying AI
former_names: Neolithic|Biomes|Biomes Academy|Biomes|Biomes Academy|Biomes|Cardinal Square Academy|Cardinal Square|Cardinal Square Academy|Cardinal Square

name: Blinka
one_liner: Banking for US companies operating globally
long_description:
Blinka is banking for US companies operating globally. 
 
Our customers incorporate in the US but run their operations, teams, and vendors from other countries. They use Blinka as their primary operating account. 
 
With Blinka, companies can: 
 
- Open a USD business account without being in the US. 
- Send money abroad without the usual 4–5% FX fees. 
- Earn yield on treasuries. 
- Issue global corporate cards with 1.5% cash back and 0 international fees. 
- Manage their financial operations with our AI tools.

name: Boat
one_liner: The best cloud VMs for billions of agents
agent_hits: agents; agents; agents; agent; agents; Agents; agents
long_description:
**Problem** 
 
Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities.  
 
Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial. 
 
**Solution** 
 
Boat provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a sandbox, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing. 
 
**Why Boat and not any other cloud VM?** 
 
1. It is ready out of the box: every sandbox ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker, snapshots, and templates, plus a CLI, SDK, API, and control pane for your fleet. 
2. It is permissive and paradigm agnostic: any number of agents can use any number of sandboxes. Agents can run inside or use sandboxes as an external tool. 
3. It is expertly crafted: we manage everything from the individual CPU to the orchestration software, which makes sandboxes stable, persistent, scalable, and secure. 
4. It is the best performance and price in town: our CPUs rank first on HPC benchmarks, and sandboxes are typically 9x to 18x cheaper than other leading sandboxes. 
 
**Further notes** 
 
Sandboxes are hosted in Europe, which keeps prices low, and more regions are coming. Unless compliance requires it, agents don't notice the region they run in.

name: Boxes.dev
one_liner: A better place to run your coding agents.
long_description: Close your laptop again. Run Claude Code and Codex on unlimited parallel cloud computers from your laptop, phone, and terminal. Bring your own subscription, start agents from Slack and Linear, and manage an agent swarm by letting your agents coordinate their work.

name: ByteAsk
one_liner: The AI coding agent for C, C++ and CUDA
long_description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for low level languages like C, C++ and CUDA, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and inference. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem. As agents run most software, the bottleneck becomes how fast and compute-efficient that software is. Our bet is that in that world software is written in assembly, and ByteAsk agents will write it.

name: Caladh
one_liner: Anti-drone defense for the maritime domain
long_description: Caladh protects critical maritime infrastructure from drone attacks above and below the waterline.  Our systems detect, track, and defeat unmanned systems so they can't get near the assets they want to disrupt.

name: Canos
one_liner: AI-powered blood test to detect cancer in dogs (and cats soon).
long_description:
Canos is bringing a human-grade liquid biopsy platform for dogs, starting with a single blood draw. We sequence cell-free DNA to perform multi-modal analysis of fragmentation, copy number variation, native methylation (5mC and 5hmC) and more to detect cancer signals. Owners bank a healthy baseline for their dog and track changes every year. Dogs already diagnosed get personalized monitoring through treatment. We partner with mobile vets and vet clinics to serve SF and NYC.  
 
Our mission is to make pet cancer curable through early detection and monitoring.

name: Capveon
one_liner: AI to find, understand, and win government work.

name: Caveman
one_liner: Infrastructure for efficient AI
long_description: Caveman is the cheapest place to build and run AI agents. It observes real agent workloads, finds cost and performance inefficiencies, tests improvements, and safely deploys the ones that work.

name: Central Blue
one_liner: The power grid for space: we build power-beaming satellites.
physical_hits: satellites; Spacecraft; Industrials -> Aviation and Space
long_description:
Spacecraft today have to generate all their own power, which caps what can be built and operated in orbit. Central Blue is building the power grid for space: satellites that collect sunlight and beam power by laser to receiver panels on other spacecraft. 
 
Our first power-beaming prototype is nearly complete in Seattle, with a laser-powered propulsion demonstration planned with Wave Motion Launch Technologies. Our CORE software will let the power satellites detect faults and recover on their own, keeping the grid running around the clock.

name: Cesara
one_liner: Faster & accurate transactions for health systems

name: ChampionEffect Inc.
one_liner: An AI coach for every employee!
long_description:
ChampionEffect is an AI Coach that teaches AI to every employee at a company, in Slack and Teams. 
 
The Coach helps with a new AI concept, a new workflow, or any tool. It jumps on a call and walks you through the work, just like a coworker would. It points to the top use cases in your industry and tailors everything to your company’s needs and tools. Every time someone does a walkthrough with the Coach, it learns how real work gets done at the company and uses that knowledge with other coworkers. 
 
Before this, we ran a YC company (Cambly) that taught English to millions of professionals and generated $100M+ in revenue. Now we’re using what we learned to teach millions about AI.

name: ChemPilot.ai
one_liner: Discover novel defense related materials/molecules.
defense_hits: defense; defense; defense; defense; dual-use; sub:Defense
long_description:
ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial and error. We compress that to months by screening for what can actually be made, then closing the loop: every lab result feeds back into the models so the next round is faster and smarter. 
 
Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. Together we bring chemical engineering, computational chemistry and AI, plus the production systems to put them to work. ChemPilot spun out of that research. 
 
The West’s defense and dual-use industrial base runs on materials with fragile, sole-source and often adversarial supply chains. Demand for new capability is surging, and materials still take decades to develop. We’re building a new kind of chemical prime: one that can discover, develop and ultimately manufacture the materials the West needs, securely, fast and at cost.

name: ClaimKit
one_liner: AI-native tax firm
long_description: AI-native tax firm, starting with R&D tax credits in the US, UK, and Australia

name: Clean
one_liner: Revenue intelligence for agents and sales teams.
long_description:
Agents can run outreach on their own now. 
 
In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone. 
 
Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal. 
 
We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.

name: Collar
one_liner: AI-Native Investor Relations
long_description:
Collar is helping enterprises fundraise faster. 
 
Traction in just 2 months:  
$1.4M deals pending compliance, half are Fortune 1000 
>30 clients including Fortune 500, NYSE and NASDAQ-listed companies. 
4X month over month revenue growth across multiple five-figure monthly enterprise contracts 
 
Multi-billion dollar enterprises are relying on a single overworked Vice President to lead their entire fundraising and  investor relations process. 
We enable a single investor relations VP to do the work of a whole analyst team, at a fraction of the usual $15K/Month consultant price. 
 
Collar’s proprietary AI harness does this by using agents to automatically target investors, reconcile data, and provide a live citation-backed teleprompter for meetings. 
 
Founders: Kazel and Jamie are both repeat founders with buy-side finance experience.  
Kazel invented a new method of hacking with Softbank research funding at 17 and previously built a deep tech health startup adopted by the national hospitals in Singapore. 
Jamie was Chief of Staff at Openspace, a billion-dollar multi-asset manager, and is also a repeat founder. 
 
They previously worked together as the youngest Singapore AI defence contractors.

name: Composal
one_liner: Always-on agents that don't need to be prompted
long_description:
Composal gives engineers always-on agents that work in the cloud, each with its own computer, Slack handle and memory.  
 
An engineer gives one a standing order, like “watch production, fix new errors, get the fix reviewed by @reviewbot and ship it” and it keeps going after the laptop closes.  
 
Our QA agents test every pull request by using the app like a real user, and have found over 1,500 bugs in customers’ apps since mid-October.

name: Confetti
one_liner: Build hardware projects using plain-English prompts
long_description: Confetti lets anybody design and build hardware projects using plain-English prompts. Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it takes one conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

name: Constor
one_liner: AI native OS for the construction industry

name: Contour
one_liner: AI-native permitting for Data Centers
long_description: Contour acquires the permitting and compliance firms behind America’s critical infrastructure, and runs them on AI.

name: CONUS
one_liner: Medical Device Platform for Hospitals
long_description:
CONUS structures fragmented medical device information for surgeons. We combine manufacturer documentation, hospital protocols and medical research in one place, giving surgeons and MedTech teams reliable answers across products and procedures through search and source-backed AI. 
 
We already work with 25 leading manufacturers including Johnson & Johnson, Stryker and Zimmer Biomet, and since launching six months ago we’re already being used in 83 hospitals, with 32 fully ramped. 
 
Long term, hospitals will use CONUS to source and order surgical devices across manufacturers.

name: Covera
one_liner: Covera gets insurance brokers to quote first and win more business.
long_description:
Insurance is one of the last big industries still running on manual work. 
 
Trillions in premium flow through brokers who still have to key the same data into their agency management system (AMS), chase clients for documents, and fill one carrier portal after another. 
 
Every hour spent on manual quoting is an hour not spent selling. Across tens of thousands of brokers, that's billions in revenue left on the table. 
 
Software never fixed it, because the work sits between systems and raters are outdated. 
 
Covera runs it end to end, with AI workflows connected to the AMS, the inbox and 100+ carrier portals. It fits the way brokers already work, so their teams can focus on advising clients and closing business. 
 
In 3 months, Covera went live with 90+ brokers in the US and Europe. Brokers now go from a client's email to a quote in 3 minutes, instead of hours. 
 
Covera is founded by repeat founders Tiphaine Venet and Thibaut Regerat, who previously built and sold Simio, a conversational AI company.

name: Cyclon
one_liner: a phone where AI is the interface
long_description: Cyclon is rebuilding the phone around AI. Instead of opening apps and tapping through screens, you tell your phone what you want and it does it for you. With one touch, you can spin up AI agents to control your phone or handle tasks in the background. AI isn’t just inside an app - it’s the phone itself.

name: Databuddy
one_liner: AI Data Analyst for fast-growing teams
long_description:
Databuddy gives you your very own data analyst, always watching over your data, combining all your context to investigate and paint a full picture on every product issue that emerges in real-time; conversion drops, user frustration and churn. 
 
It makes your product better without needing to have you look at a dashboard and spend hours figuring out the why. one click to install or switch from any dated analytics provider.

name: Decent
one_liner: Your health plan should get better year-round. Not just once a year.
long_description: Decent is a health insurance brokerage for small businesses. We compare every way to cover your team, show what each one costs, and then keep improving your plan all year. We're paid by insurance companies, so we're free to you.

name: DeepMark
one_liner: Caller ID for Voice AI
long_description: DeepMark is the authentication layer for AI voice. When an AI agent speaks, we embed a compact, machine-readable ID directly into the audio, not in metadata, which gets stripped the moment a file is touched. The ID resolves to a trust record, so a bank, a call center, or the person on the line can verify in real time who the agent is.

name: Definite
one_liner: Connect operational data with finance to see what drives the numbers.
long_description:
Definite connects operational data with finance so businesses that make, move, build or operate things can see what each production run, load and job actually cost. 
 
These businesses already record a lot: production runs, shipments, job sites, equipment hours, work orders. Finance records the same business in a different shape. Operating systems track activity by site, line, or day. The ledger tracks it by entity, account, and month. Both sets of records exist, but the link between an operating decision and its financial effect usually lives in spreadsheets and in a few people's heads. 
 
So questions that should be routine take days. What happens to cash if one plant adds a shift? How does a change in throughput or staffing flow into the forecast? Which operating changes actually moved the numbers last quarter? 
 
Definite connects to existing operational and financial systems read-only. Models propose how operational records map to financial ones and explain what they find. Deterministic rules perform the calculations and checks, so results trace back to the source records they came from.  
 
Definite started in a plant office an hour from campus, watching a controller rebuild the same spreadsheet she rebuilds every month to tie her production system to her ledger. The three of us met at the University of Waterloo and had each spent our careers on a version of that join. Gurshabd built wallet policy and approval controls at BitGo, where proving customer assets matched the ledger was still done by hand. Farhan built recommendation systems for Instagram Reels at Meta, joining billions of raw events to the numbers the business reported. Mazin built trading systems at Optiver, then agents for financial analysts at Boosted.ai, where analysts would not act on a number they could not trace. In finance that work is at least funded. In companies that make and move things, nobody had built it at all.

name: Degla Inc
one_liner: Your intent. Onboard autonomous execution.
long_description:
Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem. 
 
An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution. 
 
At the core is an onboard vision-language model that interprets what the drone sees, understands the operator’s intent, and guides mission planning, execution, and adaptation. Running locally on NVIDIA Jetson, it makes mission decisions without relying on cloud inference.

name: Deploy
one_liner: The generalist robot deployment company.
long_description: Deploy's core belief is that robots should be useful. Getting a generalist robot to do real work is fundamentally the same problem across industries. We build everything between the model and the task to bring generalist robots to the businesses that actually need them.

name: Dreamscale Labs
one_liner: Cloud inference and training infrastructure for robotics.
physical_hits: robotics; physical AI; Industrials -> Manufacturing and Robotics
long_description: Dreamscale Labs is building the fastest cloud inference platform for robotics. As complex physical AI models become difficult to fit on expensive on-robot GPUs, we let users offload inference to the cloud and serve them with real-time latency. So far, we've hit 40-50% lower latency than existing neoclouds.

name: Dualizer
one_liner: Agentic physics simulation that debottleneck manufacturing
long_description:
Dualizer (YC F26) builds agentic physics simulation to debottleneck manufacturing—from everyday essentials like food, beverages, and medicine to the fuels and advanced materials powering aviation and modern computing. 
 
High manufacturing costs and production bottlenecks can raise prices and cause shortages of essential goods. Inefficient production can waste resources and pollute the environment for decades. Design or operating failures can cause deadly incidents. Yet the engineering needed to design better processes and improve existing plants remains slow, manual, and highly specialized. 
 
Dualizer’s software platform lets engineers build physics-based digital twins, design safer processes, and optimize plant performance—boosting throughput while reducing energy use and production costs. 
 
Its ambition is to become the engineering foundation for the world’s process industries—helping startups and global manufacturers alike commercialize breakthroughs faster and make essential goods cheaper and more abundant. 
 
Same school. Same year. Same major. David Kim, Chris Donahue, and Nathan Liu met at UC Berkeley, Class of ‘27, Chemical Engineering. Their research and industry experience in process modeling, physics-based simulation, and AI/ML gave them the foundation for a shared ambition: transforming how industrial plants are designed and operated. All three were headed toward PhDs. They chose to build Dualizer.

name: Dydema
one_liner: A consumer brain-computer interface you can map to anything.
long_description: We’re building a brain-computer interface anyone can wear, so you can use a computer at the speed of thought. To get there, we’re recording brain data at model company scale.

name: Elimentary
one_liner: AI agents that run middle and back office for private credit funds
long_description:
Elimentary automates the recurring middle and back office work of private credit funds. 
Every month, fund teams receive loan files, credit agreements, bank statements and servicer reports. Analysts spend hours turning these documents into usable data, checking borrower obligations, reconciling accounts and preparing reports across spreadsheets and email. 
 
Elimentary brings this work into a coordinated team of AI agents. They standardize loan data, monitor covenants, reconcile financial records and prepare reporting for investors, fund administrators and other stakeholders. 
 
For example, our reconciliation agents compare bank records with the fund administrator’s records and prepare the reconciliation for the finance team to review. People retain final sign-off, helping funds handle more operational work without adding headcount at the same pace.

name: Elithia
one_liner: AI-native medical opinions
long_description:
US workers' compensation paid out $64.1 billion in 2023. Personal injury, malpractice, and other insurance claims add billions more. Behind every one of these claims sit thousands of pages of medical records, and a clinician spends hours or days reading them to reconstruct what happened to the patient. 
 
Elithia is building agents to do this work. 
 
Our agents reconstruct patient histories, reason across conflicting evidence, and produce defensible analyses, with every finding cited to the original record. 
 
We've sold to physician expert witnesses and medical-legal firms, turning thousands of pages into court-ready chronologies an expert can verify in minutes. Next: TPAs and insurers, where the same review sits behind every injury claim.

name: Epsilab
one_liner: Long horizon RL environments from real-life data
long_description: Applied AI research lab focused on RL for frontier model training. Our research and evals cover real-world environment simulation, long-horizon workflows, and multi-player agents, etc.

name: ernd
one_liner: The Credit Card for the AI stack
long_description:
ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. We give 4% back on AI spend and partner with AI infrastructure companies to give cardholders extra perks, like 10% back on Wafer inference, 2x usage limits on Firecrawl and 62% off Trace pen tests. The card is live for US companies. In our first week, 30+ startups requested the card and we signed 8 partners.  
 
We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions. We're also credit card nerds, with at least five cards each that we rotate to maximize points!

name: Evardi
one_liner: Agents that engineer the grid edge
long_description: At least 94% of US outage minutes start on the distribution grid, and most utilities are blind between the substation and the meter. Evardi builds a live model of a utility’s network from data it already has, matching every meter to its transformer and using virtual meters to show load and solar on every transformer. On top of that model, our AI agents do the engineering work utilities need at the grid edge: checking switching orders, finding outages after extreme weather and planning for new load from DERs and data centers. Because the model sees every transformer, it will also help utilities decide when new wires are really needed, and how distribution load can free up transmission for new data centers. We’re working with utilities across the globe that together serve over 10 million customers.

name: EveryApp
one_liner: Making every SaaS open source
long_description: EveryApp is building open source alternatives to every SaaS. It’s a platform to host these open source apps and personal software. Everything runs behind one secure sign-in in your own Cloudflare account.

name: Evident Machines
one_liner: Real-world benchmarks and RL environments for electrical engineering
long_description: Evident Machines builds benchmarks and RL environments for AI doing real-world electrical engineering. We test models on complete engineering workflows, from design and simulation to physical experiments in our SF lab. We turn these experiments into training data and environments for frontier AI labs, with the goal of enabling AI to design, test and improve real hardware.

name: Faraday
one_liner: Industrial aOS coordinating humans, agents, and machines
agent_hits: agents; agents; agents; agents; agents; agents
long_description:
Industrial and legacy enterprises still rely on people to coordinate disconnected layers of systems. Automating this work has required an FDE services approach in the past, because so much of it is bespoke and company specific. 
 
Faraday is a self-improving platform that take on this operational work. It connects to their existing software and machines and automatically builds RL environments around each company’s workflows and data. Each job the agents do is checked against those environments, and the results are used to train them. The agents get better on their own with no additional work. 
 
Continuous learning turns each company’s expertise into a compounding asset. Completed work, corrections, and employee feedback improve the agents, and those improvements carry into future jobs. The business preserves its knowledge while becoming more capable over time. 
 
As these agents take on more workflows, Faraday will be the shared runtime coordinating work between humans, agents, and robots across the business.

name: Fire Wallet
one_liner: Fire Wallet is a privacy-first crypto wallet designed to just work,…
long_description:
🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥 
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA 
 
TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal. 
 
Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet! 
 
🔥Why we built this

name: FlashDrive
one_liner: A shared drive for your team and all your AI agents.
agent_hits: agents; agents; agents; Agents; agent; agents; agents; Agents
long_description:
Our mission is to rebuild the file system, the oldest idea in computing, for its newest users: AI agents. 
 
FlashDrive is a shared drive for teams and their AI agents. You can use it via MCP or mount it like a normal folder on macOS and Linux, so your laptop, your teammates' and every sandbox work in the same live files at once. Agents hand off work through files: one writes, the next one reads. 
 
That makes AI multiplayer across a whole company. Everyone keeps the agent they already like, whether that's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or something custom, and there's no new app to learn. Your agents and your teammates' agents work in the same files and pick up where each other left off. 
 
Shared drives were built for people. Agents work differently: many of them edit the same files at once. Unlike Dropbox or Google Drive, FlashDrive merges edits made at the same time, or keeps both, instead of creating a conflicted copy. Cloud sandboxes connect with no setup, huge files stream instead of filling the disk, and every file can be searched with keywords and grep. 
 
(FlashDrive is by Evokoa, Inc.)

long_description:
Frontrunner lets GTM teams describe the work they need done and deploy agents that run it, connected to their existing tools and data. Not only does Frontrunner give those agents a shared understanding of your ICP, customers, and gtm motion, but persists that shared understanding automatically when business context changes so that it remains in sync. Sales and marketing build, run, and manage agents against that shared context, using the tools they already know. name: GatherHQ

long_description:
Gather's AI agent for enterprise GTM continually interviews real buyers and turns those conversations into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior. 
 
More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to create original, on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content.

Our models draw on quantitative, qualitative, and voice data from over 300,000 real interviews across customers, with thousands added monthly. Teams can simulate how buyers will respond to messaging, pricing, and market shifts, with supporting evidence and a confidence level behind every answer. When confidence is low, Gather automatically runs new research. 
 
We’re starting by replacing research firms and content agencies. We’re building the intelligence enterprises and their agents need to understand and serve customers, whether human or AI. 
 
Built by the team that created Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo) and Pulse (acquired by Gartner), and ran Gartner Peer Insights.

name: GodHands

long_description:
Analysts keep working real cases in the tools they already use. GodHands learns each decision and the reason behind it, then builds agents that work the next alerts the same way and keep learning as the rules change. There are no integrations and no specs to write: agents go live in weeks.

name: Gradon

long_description:
Gradon is Legora for the firms that design the world's buildings and infrastructure. Every road, bridge, water system and building starts with engineers, and there aren't nearly enough of them for everything the world needs to build.  
 
Gradon works across every workflow and tool an engineering firm runs on, from CAD design and calculations to full plan sets, and firms using it today have decreased average project times by more than 75%. We're building the platform that makes every engineer a 10x engineer, and with it, how the world gets built.

name: Graphide
one_liner: CI runner with agents that manage your tests. 10x faster and 70%…
long_description:
Graphide CI runs your CI 10× faster than GitHub runners on enterprise deployments, and our 24/7 agents optimize the CI itself, not just the machines. We cut costs 70%+ for GH (50%+ for most other runners) and take over the ongoing work of optimizing CI, so you can focus on your product. 
 
We're faster and cheaper because we own both the hardware and the optimizations and configs that run on it, which lets us do what owning only one could not. A graph of the codebase runs only the tests each change can reach, and we run your tests in parallel, so your CI is limited only by the length of your longest test. Our agents then tune machines, caches and test splits as you add more tests and code over time. We also patch the tests themselves, fixing flakes and adding our own libraries so they run faster and more reliably. 
 
Coding agents now write more code than teams can check, making verification the new bottleneck. CI is where we start, but we also cover the rest of the verification stack. Our PR review agent runs the old and new code in live environments, finding bugs and proving them by writing tests (50% more bugs found than Greptile on our benchmarks, with 35% fewer false positives). Our visualizer shows data flows and graph-based diffs so you can understand a PR in seconds.

name: GrayPass
one_liner: Verify the expected person is still in control before sensitive…
long_description:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass helps apps check who’s behind sensitive actions and whether they’re authorized before those actions go through. 
 
It combines identity, device and session context with behavioral signals like typing rhythm, cursor movement and scrolling. Before a sensitive action goes through, GrayPass evaluates that evidence against your team’s policy and returns a decision: allow, challenge, hold or deny. Your app enforces the decision. 
 
This applies to actions like exporting sensitive data, changing admin permissions or allowing an AI agent to act on someone’s behalf. Allowed actions receive short-lived, signed proof tied to the exact action and your app. 
 
Your existing login and authentication stack stays in place.

name: Grep AI
one_liner: Self-improving agents that automate your growth bottlenecks
long_description:
Grep AI is the fastest way to create, optimize, and deploy agents for tedious, complex operational work that slows down your business. Our self-improving agents learn from every run, making them smarter and cheaper as you scale. IG.com a global retail brokerage used our agents to review compliance alerts and now 80% of their customers onboad without manual intervention, doubling first trades and propelling them to a FTSE 100 company.  
 
Customers including Airwallex, Worldpay, Citizens Bank, FV Bank and Shopmonkey have used our agents to automate over 250,000 of operational work across compliance, onboarding, underwriting, corporate due diligence, document verification, merchant categorization, market and competitive research, rev ops and much more. 
 
We founded Grep AI after experiencing firsthand how manual workflows can prevent a business from growing when we ran the platform team at Brex. We're now on a mission to rid businesses of tedious, repetitive so their employees can focus on the most high leverage tasks that matter.

name: HABU

long_description:
HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield.

Starting first with multifamily in Phoenix and then expanding nationally.

long_description:

physicalvalidation.com by Halmos Labs offers an API to execute any experiment. PhysicalValidation uses compounding knowledge and an experimental design AI to coordinate experiments through contracted labs faster and cheaper.  
 
Connecting physicalvalidation.com, Codex has designed and tested a new antibiotic without human intervention.

name: Helios Intelligence
one_liner: At-home molecular body test: 1,000+ biomarkers from a drop of blood
long_description:
Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test. 
 
By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.

name: herdr
one_liner: building the open agent runtime
agent_hits: agent; agent; agent; agents; agent; agent
long_description:
Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed. 
 
Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across every project — so you look only when an agent needs you. Every client is just a view: the bundled terminal UI, SSH from another machine, your phone. Close one, open another; the work never stops. 
 
Software can drive it too: a CLI, a socket API, and a plugin marketplace that passed 500 community plugins in its first month. The runtime is Apache-2.0 and stays open. Four months after launch: 25k GitHub stars, 340k downloads.

Horizontal connects the people, software and machines that run production.
